# AI-Assisted Tests

_Last updated: Apr 22, 2026, 10:44 AM (Last updated 4 days ago)_

This feature is part of the AI Add-on. For more information, see [📄 HackerRank AI Add-on](/articles/5847651809).

HackerRank enables AI assistance for project-based coding questions to mirror real-world development environments. This feature helps candidates experience realistic workflows and allows recruiters to evaluate practical problem-solving more accurately.

The AI Assistant operates in the following modes:

- **Unguarded**: Allows candidates to interact freely with the AI, similar to real-world AI coding tools and agent-style workflows.

- **Guarded (Default)**: Provides help with syntax, platform navigation, and conceptual guidance but does not generate complete solutions.

**Note:** Contact your account manager to change the default setting or to learn more about the available modes.

The AI Assistant currently supports the following question types:

- Coding

- Database

- Data Science

- Projects

  - Frontend

  - Backend

  - Full-Stack

  - Mobile

  - Generative AI

- Code Repository
---
## Enable AI Assistant for Tests

To enable the AI Assistant:
---
### Step 1: Enable AI Assistant in Company Settings

1.  Log in to your **HackerRank for Work** account using your credentials.

2.  Go to **Settings**.

3.  Select **Test Settings** from the left panel under the **Company** section.

4.  In the **Test Evaluation** section, turn on the **AI Assistance for Candidates** toggle.

    ![image.png](https://assets.usepylon.com/e6a58e21-be80-4777-9eaf-f73beeee94d9%2F1775561672530-image.png?Expires=253370764800&Signature=OJXtg4~tQPNMMEcb38zfEWLL0y8O9aetUMghuEdngbbSJ9rkJAmf-Q2m0995l2Tt20xvJiaSmOwZ8K3QF3cg8mlo2mVfz6ZP0aBn4lAleKKoBIVMFgDOrn~dMxLxlyjunssEdSRoFU43dpNny6yqX6zocWhwlg9JVltAZLBzlHY1q74GUxA~ckCuxjS2bKLRQZ0DOPwj1WExi88rJ9yDVcTPCPwJXzL5xaDGZQHHi7KWPqU6lHAKqXEnFpDLxhQyYJAnraIkbs54LR5BTdfvqpZmlZjxFFQvlAMrjDoratGKhRafxpaQHVX9HdhoBksuJeQQAScKO82Tee3SxX47AA__&Key-Pair-Id=K3NV4LZ47N8M46)

5.  Click **Save Changes**.
---
### Step 2: Set up AI Assistant at the section level

1.  Go to the **Tests** tab.

2.  Open the test for which you want to add the AI assistant.

3.  Hover over the section name and select the **Settings** icon.

    ![image.png](https://assets.usepylon.com/e6a58e21-be80-4777-9eaf-f73beeee94d9%2F1775562265970-image.png?Expires=253370764800&Signature=j5OT0JbZYGFBHsTUHHAkjC4P~6dYFAA3AP7VUE5l9lGErbSbk7HeCISz3zvnYCfbv0O9ubcClgOH43gg5BMlQhgmz5LFGV3wgyhwLQeUtJ8btRpAwAeEGg-ktmBsCqvnCFoMJtUte99zFIA3GYKTrb4~YsBvKh8oWGQbxWBPIVjXZm0cPtztq4r4ffxhh7WDKdFoFv-L0aGCbc21l4lEot8y~ck6s-ffWy9BLwVezAXrPZ5OPmiaxNtnFZtP7nkehUjodzDPF-GeZ4ZzQCqG1Z8YmOW3Cw38ooKdLma89OsI2L58in8xV8NaKn9Tt-wMYjcM3WzzmlrBsLwW6RkWRQ__&Key-Pair-Id=K3NV4LZ47N8M46)

    - No AI assistant

    - Guarded AI assistant

## Report insights

After the test is complete, the candidate report displays AI-specific interaction data.

- **AI Assistant Transcript:** This transcript shows the full conversation between the candidate and the AI assistant in the **Detailed Report**. It is enabled by default for all AI-Assisted Tests.

  ![DDDDFDD.png](https://assets.usepylon.com/e6a58e21-be80-4777-9eaf-f73beeee94d9%2F1754474711048-DDDDFDD.png?Expires=253370764800&Signature=L0OKNQlKFqs6FIBLLXgr0puBM~fRzapj-VDPZqqBi4v~uPjGpMwLnXgmeBJepkpAnaKHA0rXZ-bKKE82pdslT4u7gTc7VpsLvgKRNYaEiC-eYGDfN7bs2YepqGA0dK7r5zi4PTeoK~nYuep78T~Pk~cLO2vkR9bXiPvQKPDQwv9WUJfQcA7jwVqLgvOk5Y7b5sXflrNa9JFBEZf5MGu1UtvI6UrplIFpelGeiDAn86ut-EDDEIGRAmDYhPhNoxFC50mK1EXwb6yWNxtMMGdybX0EODZQNJI0cRb~MyXl-gY6veN~81UojfnW673HLrOHqt3yYEMZ9vGlADIKwuzSUg__&Key-Pair-Id=K3NV4LZ47N8M46)

<!-- -->

- **AI Fluency** (optional): Provides recruiters with a holistic view of how candidates interact with the AI assistant during a test. For more information, see [📄 AI Fluency](/articles/1773201418).
---
## Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)

**Does the AI-Assisted Summary work in proctored tests?**

Yes. In proctored tests, the **Performance Summary** appears in the new reports interface.

**Can I view the AI Fluency in older reports?**

In the classic reports view, the AI Fluency is available only at the question level, but not at the test level.

**Is the AI Fluency reliable?**

Refer to the [📄 AI Fluency](/articles/1773201418)article.

**When should I use the Unguarded AI Assistant?**

You can use the Unguarded AI Assistant when you want to evaluate how candidates work with AI in real-world, agent-style workflows.

# HackerRank Certified Assessments

_Last updated: Feb 7, 2025, 3:16 PM (Last updated 1 year ago)_
---
## What is a Certified Assessment? 

HackerRank Certified Assessments are pre-built role-specific tests created after long-term research and analysis of the questions that match the industry standards for the given role and assure a quality outcome from the screening process. 

These Certified Assessments follow industry norms and design a universal test for a specific role. Any company that wants to hire for that role can use this single test to assess its candidates. This provides an unbiased interview experience for both the companies and the candidates.
---
## Benefits

- **100% HackerRank Managed Screening:** HackerRank entirely manages these assessments. You do not have to depend upon your recruiting and engineering teams to create the test questions or manage the test.  

- **Unbiased Assessments:** HackerRank uses a third-party content bias checker that helps to provide an unbiased assessment experience.  

- **Leakage Protected Skill Bundles:** You will not be required to keep a tab on your tests to check if a question is leaked. HackerRank automatically detects and removes the leaked questions and replaces them with new questions. The leak detection process runs daily, and questions are flagged immediately once detected during the daily run.

- **Robust Plagiarism Detection:** HackerRank provides the market's most powerful plagiarism detection software to detect malpractice. 

- **Accurate Classification:** Our team has built a machine-learning-powered role mapping engine that conducts in-depth research by scanning thousands of job descriptions throughout the industry. This approach helps us accurately list the skills required for a specific job role. 

- **No Repetition:** HackerRank follows a 10-step robust evaluation process to select questions. The possibility of two developers getting the same question is 1 in 1000.
---
## Creating a Certified Assessment 

- Click on the **Create Test** option and select the role for which you want to assess the candidates. 

- Search for the desired role or the skill you want to assess. If the role you selected has a Certified Assessment you can see the badge as shown in the below picture. 

- A Certified Assessment is categorized into skill-based sections. You can see the skills mapped to the role you have selected. You can add or remove these roles in the next step.

![2024-10-23_11-55-56.png](https://assets.usepylon.com/e6a58e21-be80-4777-9eaf-f73beeee94d9%2F1734046338704-?Expires=253370764800&Signature=QbXwsZMEfBFfSjO8GOSzuOJkWpWYzc65baWF~G3leV2FuVfXr0fsz9jSASr55SCutn0xn2IzEFfRYucLW9BoowWsQuW~jELH1ivNC7E~PvyKWC~5MbffxohD6px3xPQGt-CieWpecuzkxax1AfuLtYm3HziLhOGpyJeEBbOydQvliVuPYd6O3~jPv7lQ0PGmKzWr0HrAmePqsHN8U1CqXUpo-H6qadgnEkU0FXxwuSZCe1MEotYskiPzXckNa5q4l6OxoP3Iql9L4OapvI-r~bP1~6EK0mSV2VgNgd7mMua8NS8T34lwfjGzUJXBwtXwiSfl-eT8K4stsNf2xvDuBQ__&Key-Pair-Id=K3NV4LZ47N8M46)

**Tip**: You can access the [HackerRank Roles Directory](https://www.hackerrank.com/roles-directory/) to view the skills mapped to each role.

- On the test page, you can access details such as the selected role, core skills mapped to that role, and other relevant skills. You can click on the **+** icon beside the relevant skills to add them to your assessment.  

![2024-10-23_11-59-39.png](https://assets.usepylon.com/e6a58e21-be80-4777-9eaf-f73beeee94d9%2F1734046339127-?Expires=253370764800&Signature=Ap9UOCssIXTIB-6Xo2E8elwTpIl7UqSIcoDAHrd7LPt3KXesXK5chEn~~PfsScsLqeWpYX5HhvUWCQwyEbFaIfcqsmS57-e0ar21DQmXplPXxt4R76Q10JNBVyZprdpvAdrNZ7MujPWm68AMJkv-TeubBveHbKdbxaZ4NxX20WzQZHTqM9jKTTJfkXamm1cgNH5jfCBWr85PKCoNCbQ-WxS-dsJ-1Lg4rTuvzSVNRVMg-shRn2Wc830KGxQaH0Qv-AMbjAlDDn~pH0H9D7c0WPw3xxDxaYu9uVY4D~dFWUicaoSR6GMmD99FjEArscTo9sx62Uaklj6SK7~7awRtdw__&Key-Pair-Id=K3NV4LZ47N8M46)

## Section Level Settings
---
### Shuffling Sections

You can rearrange the order of skill bundles within a test. To reorder the skill bundles, hover your mouse cursor over a skill bundle, and while keeping the mouse button pressed, drag the skill bundle upwards or downwards to the desired position. This allows you to easily shuffle and reorder the sequence of skill bundles per your preference within the test.

<img src="https://assets.usepylon.com/e6a58e21-be80-4777-9eaf-f73beeee94d9%2F1734046339525-?Expires=253370764800&amp;Signature=tw9kiSyQkRcox2X3cGYKOQsleq4vNDo~lAPL1ISABDmwn9X~XHsrQb47vBevQ7mPhqBS-TEzCr7Y3A53gmIIwkIrRNIFou949Dr4331yi6jBGN9KOs~C2j3dDATvMsq-UXGu8aamD2LZhpMIrgEJZdH~0oEc~xN2tuGHIoKVq7vlyy5MNyPUnQpuMNAMTbZHMf0Ov6OeK0U5pmFEhkRMglQcT25nWEQJnuNJ8I-JYPW07wo90AUAON-LjRvJqdPj0-msXVQRC52OBouX-DLk9qQBpwznD0qdOozWlVC~ymicPqAW8cb6gKZCY5dLezC4Obivs-4EpP5jCecIO86mCg__&amp;Key-Pair-Id=K3NV4LZ47N8M46" class="kb-image block" data-drag-handle="false" />
---
### Skill Bundle Settings

- Hover over the skill section and click on the **settings** icon 

- Within the skill section settings, you can change its name, select the number of questions, and change the time limit to answer that section.  

- From the Advanced Settings, you can: 

  - Control if you want the candidates to see the sections when disabled candidates will only see the questions within a test.  

  - Enable or disable the sections to be shuffled for the candidates. 

  - Allow or disallow the candidates to revisit previous sections once answered.  

  - Allow the candidates to use the duration left in previous sections for the upcoming sections.  

<img src="https://assets.usepylon.com/e6a58e21-be80-4777-9eaf-f73beeee94d9%2F1734046339915-?Expires=253370764800&amp;Signature=rv24rRelgx4rxYNaaAaEse91FEhuoT5dYJi1hP9ZFuaCq-UNK7v5NNyu2xVGCoR5b6v1bbZfDVNg9DifmKKF6gHlPAj9knLo~TZ~AyvPEl2PzUORThgHE5hHLJCliBl3K2aEQiDzUg7yikHBXX9Z0vu9hG9zX04D9rbd2Y3s~03DETO0vwpVWKVkohX4CsaM~Ine0DtLXWFrVyIMGR7B3kuZ1lVgzM~B0wWfXnl8rh-fL-CXixxF38FoAmrwSxAQJQH74iFFgE9g5Y7jrZjtHVoHTVTgrl7mrTInbYQCbfwpo76nEYJj7c1u7-xzaYX239u-6wzBkx0irA75nid7dw__&amp;Key-Pair-Id=K3NV4LZ47N8M46" class="kb-image block" data-drag-handle="false" />
---
### Leaked Question Replacement Indicator

- Whenever a leaked question is automatically replaced, you will be notified with an indicator within the test. 

- You can click on the **Review** button to view the questions that have been leaked and replaced. This will help you check the accuracy of the replaced question compared to the original.

![AQR Final sn (1).gif](https://assets.usepylon.com/e6a58e21-be80-4777-9eaf-f73beeee94d9%2F1734046340571-?Expires=253370764800&Signature=J9dXphNXWmN96dQPuScJViQLEJpWwBKSWZoMDTftONpnMtu3SaS8rUylM7zOs0zWSocojR~RUCSrUmuzOKHBErol3uCbKeCxcbWt8ueC4LfUUHmIVShVLthvfaBnWgcwrIQ7d1zm~MhrnuXsXpW9Rt9WVW1FzXwU0lg9BZ5fvg5J~ZAWAXIQ0RyO7CrPgNQui5f5ZRavXdA5Iq7J4mbD7BNAVk6elqq21q5Iwrx81POvUdKrE5KztLNdbZZiYE92guQqF5LKb5puBGVieii3FcSlVj3c49MxVbfSkTUr2BA~IWs8gkPTK4W5vhERTI6bGi~ugfHnhzdt7YDXZOJ3Qg__&Key-Pair-Id=K3NV4LZ47N8M46)

**Note**:

- Automatic question replacements work for all the published tests, even if locked.

## Customizing The Skills 

Coming to customization, if you feel that skill is not needed for the role you are hiring or want to test an additional skill in the candidates, you can customize the assessment at the skill level.  

**Important Note**: When you add or remove a skill, the test will lose its Certified Assessment status
---
### Adding a New Skill

-  Click on **Add New+** and select from the available options: 

  - **Add Skill-Based Questions:** Add questions curated by HackerRank and mapped to each skill.

  - **Add Manually:** Add questions from HackerRank or My Company library. 

<img src="https://assets.usepylon.com/e6a58e21-be80-4777-9eaf-f73beeee94d9%2F1734046340996-?Expires=253370764800&amp;Signature=oliRT0Gw4DuU9bNE0Rf0hJ8DpEceTyH6u5PP0byNqXmSliBxo~J8OnVQTsH84MMUWSs6MdwWiOWdZTxi3BikDfLigduRYIagQDqMvSImALnFEmfCL0FOeaPoinoD2IVxdR9FjF2xuqQoFNVtPlgJPmB9gHOjqDITQcwQxTaMyU8xuC4tTQFEl4BIfCO4AjHpCH12xc4U5BMhHj5f8yIJC7RfbbGINDGmg9HpBRX8~FYso0tb-75C2-GTI~OF216YTqFcbhufWeLLD7EpZR-PKaumTNu9NXPS15UJGlBFy3n33r3UA2ZwDePnCXbOoG35RCP4TAoPRRB-0EfAUs7wBg__&amp;Key-Pair-Id=K3NV4LZ47N8M46" class="kb-image block" data-drag-handle="false" />

- If you select Add Skill-Based Questions, you will be asked to choose the skills.

There are two types of skill bundles: 

- **Basic Skill Bundles:** These are standard skill bundles. The questions in these bundles are mapped to specific skills. 

- **Leak Protected Skill Bundles: **

  - The questions in these skill bundles are safeguarded against leakage 

  - HackerRank exclusively manages these skill bundles. If any questions from these bundles are leaked, HackerRank replaces the compromised questions with new ones.

  - Leak-protected skill bundles are highlighted with the safeguard icon, as shown below. 

<img src="https://assets.usepylon.com/e6a58e21-be80-4777-9eaf-f73beeee94d9%2F1734046342019-?Expires=253370764800&amp;Signature=b108N~flkK3HRwP62lpEFH8YQjg6BwhzG1bH0UCcN-3zdEMB-WACpRXpisCXuhfJGNAzNk4fm9ff2lQh1sXFC-snzvrQQQOVq51SB5poQ0c5Da8LLlVunDijPQSupNBgVMXYD7azmXOJPoVE~54rSqQBGiN9MhzPoi73Rrz-if~VxWy9Odqn-vhim7opH799n7Eeb25Fs~O5p29utbr0Ymq2zphOWIx2w5nWkzx9caVFjgreHiM66tx~KNtaiG3J1k3ChEjnrTzYk1HgRhGQ0jXASxbx~5YljZnN2VyAujKklpEClzhuhqjp9Rs9XFezzy~F~iTpvefHENCXXKaWKA__&amp;Key-Pair-Id=K3NV4LZ47N8M46" class="kb-image block" data-drag-handle="false" />

**Note: **Basic skill bundles do not support automatic question replacement. In case of a question leak, you must manually replace the question in that test.

- The skills are differentiated at three levels: 

  - **Basic**: Consists of questions with easy difficulty. 

  - **Intermediate**: Consists of questions with medium difficulty.

  - **Advanced**: Consists of questions with hard difficulty. 

- Next, you can choose the **Question Type**, such as Coding, MCQ, or Project type.

- After selecting the desired skill and question type, click **Add to the test.** The selected skill will appear in a new section, and the test duration will change accordingly.

<img src="https://assets.usepylon.com/e6a58e21-be80-4777-9eaf-f73beeee94d9%2F1734046342361-?Expires=253370764800&amp;Signature=mG3yqyenABhR-mHnlEB~8y737HQ8-ZbFp4pMFDPnnMTgXGM2CS2clOmuhljr~8Q2gkhH2tmhet-wqEGnXN84XWvsfiG2UzLRxOjp2XzeN57DfkW933j3BeGr-aLGJrNJ7mRLEUyp7GiAFq21e~GbarHTw0MKuhQnK2DSZTdZ-gyr1N33h69~PtHkBrSbZpSVIuz3GMtrQyOg5UporoEmHHc8sBCv3Ngczr-thstHTPd-fNPK0YV8NvVaOyyZ-zGzRGHqHCs37St-urijWQ7X0HlTs-UBxSCcLPHC~aC8WZIE7Nyw80eCY~VxFo0ZU9PFgSEws0Hh23w12WQc0H7xzg__&amp;Key-Pair-Id=K3NV4LZ47N8M46" class="kb-image block" data-drag-handle="false" />
---
### Adding Questions From the Library

- Select the **Add Manually** option after clicking **Add New+**

<img src="https://assets.usepylon.com/e6a58e21-be80-4777-9eaf-f73beeee94d9%2F1734046342801-?Expires=253370764800&amp;Signature=QVx6JqXOqz74XP~upPQUDJO6puTk3rBIGZBOlDAGIXPOHb5gQ0RzmspKSu0G~kdPaKowQeCGz3sGS~lUgpr8GFHeINKtPtMnTUwej0eLUX8gMRrVOZogbUruTF~OIZr71TicS7s5sgFoIOmB~hSOS4iE~Gz~hT-8XbpD9ofkHniSzNq0FCpHsiJBPjXI~Zq3kRvhnwO28FwKSabhcJi6FkWGdr~kev7UZgBgwYPlOid3IhFE5F1VZw5OGVI1VhoNLxgy0syLkIxkd~SvwNUcSskw0V~8EDoHxJLw0RToa0mvWW-R3csF1Cr88EYToYgP~LWMtHctvaylvh1nU0dKyQ__&amp;Key-Pair-Id=K3NV4LZ47N8M46" class="kb-image block" data-drag-handle="false" />

- Select the **Add From Library** or **Create Question** option.  

<img src="https://assets.usepylon.com/e6a58e21-be80-4777-9eaf-f73beeee94d9%2F1734046343148-?Expires=253370764800&amp;Signature=UlSem2mOByD4DZ74YsI~CvDeRrr1~GdxS2wUsx-9eM~TjuIBAL7DQ6XVRM8j1mOxgDZDDnASnGeaL9UcPDN~t17UPWGBVcyi3ol6-8GgYNMlUH-COaQHWr1288DY2FjAqtl28PKGCzOrbQzLG7Pl7YolM1WJRtHlt34ZvvpCeEto6N6Pa2-PRLHVVDQ~3K6-3Emq1vLkMElcX5ImF6i2NGbd4-hnWG~fUKzUdo41~s7oFx6tnIPLAe-WWuxQaGfMvW8FZDZjba6QFyBvRfnJxCSAD5e5xdykYUe55BoHTK~Xd9Fq~Tv7xE6cgX9zcC2tixPpg5-zhzHTVyY~HiN7vA__&amp;Key-Pair-Id=K3NV4LZ47N8M46" class="kb-image block" data-drag-handle="false" />

- When you select **Add From Library**, you will be taken to the HackerRank library, where you can select the desired question using the available filtering options. Click on the **+** icon to add the question.  Selected questions will appear on the right pane of the screen. 

<img src="https://assets.usepylon.com/e6a58e21-be80-4777-9eaf-f73beeee94d9%2F1734046343508-?Expires=253370764800&amp;Signature=DxslKrzemJt7frLdebB6e9rLyYSFtfuzW2b6~oQVNTAaY7X5b1hKNrL0XLb~PvRthLTGIRFwXf1jLS2SLB5Yth8aQbfyt3VoMJJylPcFAeLYyjVpbvvZDL9pr6hcCazGcvPT8dyy89mk8gB07Iil9M4DAhlRQVe5KfhZvf553z0S8x4Fq6UplDHr6DQOyCA~c0Aex8tRmcCB~R7NLNQVjDDJ4Q5s0VtIwv9HZmQtmVJ76DLfrtjmbQ2RQDPm7SfPnJL-aOowESBTrrjifxTvhD9LCopgtrrcULOC59srPXYYH7KKVC~U5eDDWebzqyitX4GYYm4NanduuW55eDe4Bw__&amp;Key-Pair-Id=K3NV4LZ47N8M46" class="kb-image block" data-drag-handle="false" />

- Once you've completed it, you can click on **Go back** **to test** to proceed with the test. Selected questions are added as a section.   

<img src="https://assets.usepylon.com/e6a58e21-be80-4777-9eaf-f73beeee94d9%2F1734046343868-?Expires=253370764800&amp;Signature=W03-qEPt89noeWTeJX9hrWmNNYmfLrk8~mvBp5prQmSsoylt-F85pWomWkihXmrL4TI00Re0CBKedpk2iOm8bi-yZhdPtKnJ5HESZBIx~Kz6V6sWc8XBhBfRDzyidRV9vHzz27tmyjpMNSYOyaLD-ud0O0oFS-QVgl6ENKOhkySxvMQEbS4e17da8c63uVlha~cua56DToIXPE3C8nuF0UX5ep847YxraO45mKWi1zq5XWzW1Brjt70Biy8TatYmXKENNJiP7vIYWSadDei7x14QgHl9ckE~X5JLz5eiqUh0WwuSCr14~mH~wMzM~LXi-tl2NsMIdJ2V2uUkRQFBRw__&amp;Key-Pair-Id=K3NV4LZ47N8M46" class="kb-image block" data-drag-handle="false" />

### Skill Bundle Settings

- Hover over the skill section and click on the **settings** icon 

- Within the skill section settings, you can change its name, select the number of questions, and change the time limit to answer that section.  

- From the **Advanced Settings**, you can: 

  - Control if you want the candidates to see the sections when disabled candidates will only see the questions within a test.  

  - Enable or disable the sections to be shuffled for the candidates. 

  - Allow or disallow the candidates to revisit previous sections once answered.  

  - Allow the candidates to use the duration left in previous sections for the upcoming sections.  

**Note**: You must add **duration** to each section to enable the above three settings.   

<img src="https://assets.usepylon.com/e6a58e21-be80-4777-9eaf-f73beeee94d9%2F1734046344527-?Expires=253370764800&amp;Signature=ORNzVdK7ZQUR2FCqmJARWakHL-2VFfapNQE4hC9r3jrRx-NyUHHuZldmxL6MadnBe3A4YYmCVsEJV5-r37DXNP1ipOJIN~u~rmM2w9xVpR6el-YZrRwNpYa30pp296zQpei1PBM-7nBTja0wgJTTyOo1IWfZmrkZoiGdLBCP7v7EhsYLQhpvV2kUAF~PKXOItGHf9YD-OaxzXtce-sT8CP6DGbL0WqfuUZ4hNeJ9y6VDsEnoj8jOd~vMUrvxsvYh8v0W01ZAMJiBwE1H8neLwJCEeHINSHXIsNDwvxeDbt5pxP-awolLp-m~Q3P9NxwR~pifZ0b4ZKcckU4gn1lXcQ__&amp;Key-Pair-Id=K3NV4LZ47N8M46" class="kb-image block" data-drag-handle="false" />

### Removing a Skill Section

Hover your cursor over the skill you want to remove and click the **delete** icon. This will remove the skill section you chose.

<img src="https://assets.usepylon.com/e6a58e21-be80-4777-9eaf-f73beeee94d9%2F1734046344946-?Expires=253370764800&amp;Signature=ov1HmU95JMxhc7~WfkhXjAR4VsCsfcBvb8yUY~Z-Pdx0SpdvgTB~s1egel3XxxGdSA6xx4uxwJyig~b0rfK1sN9-hKzhRHBMSKKilyMWI6PdCiy5xCFkfMaJVCmThIKFwgJH-cR1XmakQ-1s96S1tximGbv8QJByUxm-VvYCSBVASzJyP9d70D7Vrolzn5Y7e~w9YQwdgSH0VKsUdpddpOq8~c~RhZnqSQxKN5LK~e1PiqKPMbmy3sKyXG77aX9XxNVKSbgSO9N9AeihAXlTNGOHL8o5oDZDAs~0LlNAZwqgft6ZuRAKPwdXd1oRu1YZZqiN6IV7y1YKCmWCaaCebw__&amp;Key-Pair-Id=K3NV4LZ47N8M46" class="kb-image block" data-drag-handle="false" />

Once done, you can **Publish** the test and start inviting the candidates.

<img src="https://assets.usepylon.com/e6a58e21-be80-4777-9eaf-f73beeee94d9%2F1734046345357-?Expires=253370764800&amp;Signature=XlpqRhZc~xZa1Ahoi11clAW2u6ihWdBWBPXyZZY7fFY8rXGcJ2p~6Bq474V3CJXgi1Jc6YxhtK8nT5dQweEKPQ7TJMj-sgp8aV82y38zrR9J4t3-6VsjKkcqmz8eHKAFLpa5ADBleXjYxLzNbdIGEPOK5F~GT6JQ~5j38qNRQdJQNq52WbEVsxlsgSgE8KeFTy53EUFZRztiOlYd0TXjwvXohKgyJ3Nm-MXEx7nV27FlRtW9jWR4LS3BYp3T1C1JHuWYT~jyztsNlmM2XV5v-HFh~YO1WMS4KrZTVUcIFCip4fZ5HXW~UY4yuUmpptrcSgK1Yfc02kF1AHvsgc~G-w__&amp;Key-Pair-Id=K3NV4LZ47N8M46" class="kb-image block" data-drag-handle="false" />

A developer license is usually assigned to a software developer or technical manager within the company.<br /> <br /> Click [](https://support.hackerrank.com/hc/en-us/articles/115008320348-Types-of-Licenses-#interviewer-license) [here](https://support.hackerrank.com/articles/9603546665-types-of-user-roles#developer-6) to learn more.</p></td> </tr> <tr> <td data-colspan="1" data-rowspan="1" style="width: 50%"><p>Team Admin </p></td> <td data-colspan="1" data-rowspan="1" style="width: 50%"><p>This is a type of user who has complete access to manage other users within their team,<br /> add or remove users and change the permissions of existing users. A team admin usually has a recruiter or developer license.<br /> <br /> Click [](https://support.hackerrank.com/articles/9611303302-introduction-to-team-admin) [here](https://support.hackerrank.com/articles/9611303302-introduction-to-team-admin) to learn more. </p></td> </tr> <tr> <td data-colspan="1" data-rowspan="1" style="width: 50%"><p>Company Admin </p></td> <td data-colspan="1" data-rowspan="1" style="width: 50%"><p>This type of user has complete access to manage all the teams within the company, including all tests, questions, and interviews, and modifying company-level settings. A company admin usually has a recruiter or developer license.<br /> <br /> Click [here](https://support.hackerrank.com/articles/9603546665-types-of-user-roles#company-admin-2) to learn more.</p></td> </tr> <tr> <td data-colspan="1" data-rowspan="1" style="width: 50%"><p>Roles </p></td> <td data-colspan="1" data-rowspan="1" style="width: 50%"><p>There are job positions in any company for which candidates are hired. At HackerRank, it is a collection of different skills that match the skills required for a particular job opening.</p></td> </tr> <tr> <td data-colspan="1" data-rowspan="1"><p>Flexible User Roles</p></td> <td data-colspan="1" data-rowspan="1"><p>Feature that allows company admins to adjust granular permissions for all users with

# Scoring Certified Assessments

_Last updated: Mar 12, 2025, 12:56 AM (Last updated 1 year ago)_
---
## Overview

HackerRank Certified Assessments allow you to assign weightage to skills and decide the cutoff score for a certified assessment.

**Important questions answered:**

- How can the top 10, 25, or 50% of candidates who have completed a certified assessment be identified?

- How can you determine the cut-off scores for a certified assessment?

  - Need more information on [Cutoff Scores for assessments](https://support.hackerrank.com/hc/en-us/articles/115006147187-Modifying-Score-Settings-for-Tests)?
---
## Weighting of Skills 

Adjusting the weighting of specific skills being evaluated within a Certified Assessment.

- Why weight skills?

  - Weighting the value of each skill evaluated in a Certified Assessment enables easy identification and segmentation of top performers.

- How does the scoring method work for Certified Assessment?

  - Hiring teams assign weights to skills based on their needs for any specific certified assessment.

    - **Note:** Default weight values are provided but can be customized.

  - Candidates who have taken the assessment are bucketed together into performance tiers. (Top 10%, Top 25%, and Top 50%)

  - HackerRank will then reduce the scores based on the weights you and your hiring team(s) assigned or default system-assigned weights.

  - Average scores were then established for each tier.

    - The average score can then easily be used to determine the performance of any candidate compared to the scoring average for the performance tiers.
---
### Sample scenario explaining the scoring method

1.  A certified Assessment is created to evaluate two skills.

    - Section 1: PS Basic - Coding

    - Section 2: SQL Basic - Coding 

2.  A recruiter assigns weights to skills. (Weighting below)

    - Weightage of PS Basic = 40%

    - Weightage of SQL Basic = 60%

3.  Candidate Mary has taken a Software Intern Test with two sections. 

    - Section 1: PS Basic - Coding 

      - **The section score** of the candidate is 45/50

    - Section 2: SQL Basic - Coding 

      - **The section score** of the candidate is 50/75

    - **Total Score** 95/125 = 76%

4.  HackerRank uses results collected through the assessment to provide the average score for performance tiers, including:

    - Top 10%

    - Top 25%

    - Top 50%

|                       |                     |                      |              |
|-----------------------|---------------------|----------------------|--------------|
| Tiers                 | PS (Basic) - Coding | SQL (Basic) - Coding | Final Scores |
| Top 10% of candidates | 30.4                | 43.2                 | 73.6         |
| Top 25% of candidates | 29.2                | 41.4                 | 70.6         |
| Top 50% of candidates | 28                  | 36                   | 64           |

 

**How is this helpful?**

- Candidate Mary earned 95 of 125 possible points while taking the certified assessment, equaling 76%. Compared to the average for various performance tiers, Mary is clearly a top performer in the top 10% and is now easily identifiable.

- Noting the average score for the various performance tiers can help determine a poignant cutoff score to help differentiate the top performers.

**Note:** the final percentage can change depending on the weighting selected by the recruiters for each section. 

**How can weighting alter the scores? (Sample scenario with updated scoring)**

- Though the final percentage seems similar in the above example, it can change depending on the weighting selected by the recruiters for each section.

- Let’s say a  recruiter assigns weights to skills. (Weighting below)

  - Weightage of PS Basic = 30%

  - Weightage of SQL Basic = 70%

\

# Quick Start Guide for Recruiters

_Last updated: Feb 13, 2025, 2:07 PM (Last updated 1 year ago)_

HackerRank is a technology hiring platform designed to help companies efficiently hire skilled developers in a remote-first world. It enables objective evaluation of tech talent at every stage of the recruiting process. This article introduces the key features of HackerRank Screen to help you get started.
---
### HackerRank Library

The HackerRank Library is a centralized repository containing pre-built questions of various complexities and types, covering multiple programming languages. This feature helps you create Tests aligned with your hiring requirements, enabling skill-based and experience-driven candidate assessments.

The library includes:

- Ready-made questions curated by HackerRank to match job roles.

- Categorization by language, complexity, and skill type.

- The ability to create custom questions is stored in the **My Company Questions** section.

- Options to manage shared questions among team members.

![image.png](https://assets.usepylon.com/e6a58e21-be80-4777-9eaf-f73beeee94d9%2F1738610832664-image.png?Expires=253370764800&Signature=JWkfbgQ7odtmcrITHT7gzI6nm0y71z5pCPyjzX4R9nddjXidjuaPE1N-U0X04N5pU87I6W6k9a2MVKYiTtRyb0MMLJA7c~g~8CDJDfrlvMc9aQXB9G-V1UI6DCjLyTsPvQUMWcJtimDeC1zcfyydSYkdl2oPZ1LNonVcrpj0hB~3qP1wrTLHraY3tBBdV9SUhTyc6Ru-Qs4kFH6rNUsG2WuwC2u~cLlVtVKc~Ca1HF5UOExyf-pxUtIHn1b-oeB0yNV-gNfaqtbUU605XOpptW22D64QJgKjA7qVbfqmNYbTBDvwBO2hfxOlaJF2~s1uCO1FAI1dYCvEcxa2iPerjA__&Key-Pair-Id=K3NV4LZ47N8M46)
---
### Tests

HackerRank allows you to create Tests to evaluate candidates’ skills for specific roles or custom requirements. Follow these steps to create a Test:

1.  Go to the **Tests** page and click **Create Test**.

2.  Choose an applicable role to create a test.

3.  Add questions from the Library or your custom question repository using the **Add from Library** option.

4.  Filter questions by role, skill, difficulty, and more to match the Test's requirements.

Refer to:

- [Creating Certified Assessments](https://support.hackerrank.com/articles/1649328687-hackerrank-certified-assessments)

- [Creating a Custom Test](https://support.hackerrank.com/articles/2031393332-creating-a-custom-test)

![image.png](https://assets.usepylon.com/e6a58e21-be80-4777-9eaf-f73beeee94d9%2F1738610931196-image.png?Expires=253370764800&Signature=dWeK3ft-W7Q-9gWBoakJIVwyjNa4LB9~FV6nNZwf6sPOxIrSScQEiuCpbhW-2Cdlos685aH6-2QOMbjEGh2EHhT~ReW4MlZUiH6~OmQD7duLs-F2mbCHfqqjfX8mFbSGgIT-UeqvZY-D1p-x43orS9-CnBW3VB~TqdciOA4aj7uJA89dqAmplNMwD7YmX0Oa10bqB08uSZ-0McywVp~zbobCzZfw~kM-sAbE8tDrUE-mc20dd~uydQxiZ0xx4A74eepeqQlKrm3G6FDkkwaj5597oltXraIN31K1lTluczoFQ~nQ~pW10-83sRqBhTdQCkT1CFd~GtS2cKxyjz8boQ__&Key-Pair-Id=K3NV4LZ47N8M46)

For additional guidance, visit the [](https://support.hackerrank.com/articles/5297005851-hackerrank-academy) [HackerRank Academy](https://support.hackerrank.com/articles/5297005851-hackerrank-academy) to access on-demand training courses on test creation, working with the Library, and more.
---
### Test Settings

Test settings allow you to configure options such as:

- Candidate access

- Test scoring

- Question display

- Time accommodations

To modify settings:

1.  Navigate to the **Tests** page and select the desired Test.

2.  Click **Settings** and adjust options from the tabs on the left panel.

Refer to related articles for specific configurations:

- [Modifying Candidate Settings for Tests](https://support.hackerrank.com/articles/6890796492-modifying-candidate-settings-for-tests)

- [Proctoring HackerRank Tests](https://support.hackerrank.com/articles/1079706165-proctoring-hackerrank-tests)

![image.png](https://assets.usepylon.com/e6a58e21-be80-4777-9eaf-f73beeee94d9%2F1738610964228-image.png?Expires=253370764800&Signature=Lln~y~~6dUI9Ni5qzp6aobjxlM3hXYlfK9who8nKTv1wuBn7UpQu6Tx0P6Jg9slLhKylcFld4gtapP0Lj-0ZZSqBLklTQqfzahjKkxFU2~dDGWNTTl9vxVd9a2FWB-W1XdIbVhQpOkacsLzUQ-VUZ0NtR~Ae0SPSjVfKt-IUPfU-WrC6VvWR~WR3b0~3u17HOvSZPdOapiyuS6iD9gL-IxWeU8pVRZzOpLk05cInfcZnpD35aGYmhZbdUkNuMvS1D7-eyamo1o55xKViGA~cWNlPy~BcQq2qyuF0iZBjYfYitjKymwpzdpspZ7rt5uVH7rT1em1Cr9H75lLQlhX6gA__&Key-Pair-Id=K3NV4LZ47N8M46)
---
### Inviting Candidates

Invite candidates to a Test via email. To send invitations:

1.  Publish the Test.

2.  Click **Invite** and enter candidate email addresses or upload a CSV file.

3.  Customize the email using templates or saved formats.

**Note**: Recruiters must have a valid license to send invitations.

\
---
### Test Insights and Reports

#### Test Insights

The **Test Insights** page provides performance analytics to refine your hiring process, including trends and effectiveness metrics.

#### Candidate Reports

Access detailed reports on candidate performance, including code quality and plagiarism detection. Reports can be downloaded as PDFs or Excel files for external sharing.

For more details:

- [Viewing Detailed Test Reports](https://support.hackerrank.com/articles/8263794320-viewing-a-candidate's-detailed-test-report)

- [Downloading PDF and Excel Test Reports](https://support.hackerrank.com/articles/1786677446-downloading-pdf-and-excel-test-reports)
---
### HackerRank Interviews

HackerRank Interviews offers a real-time, interactive platform for conducting technical assessments. Interviews replicate an in-person experience while enabling collaborative problem-solving.

Explore additional resources:

- [Introduction to Interviews](https://support.hackerrank.com/articles/9059560249-introduction-to-hackerrank-interviews)

- [Interviewing with HackerRank](https://support.hackerrank.com/articles/8981400034-interviewing-with-hackerrank)

# Reinvite Candidates to a Test Prerequisites Reinviting candidates to a test

_Last updated: Dec 4, 2025, 3:13 PM (Last updated 5 months ago)_

If a candidate experiences an issue such as a power outage or loss of internet connection, you can reinvite them to retake the test at any time. You do not need to delete the previous invite or attempt before sending a new one.

**Note:** When you reinvite a candidate, their previous report is automatically deleted. To recover a deleted report, contact [support@hackerrank.com](mailto:support@hackerrank.com).
---
# Prerequisites

- The candidate must have already been invited to or attempted the test.

- You must have a Recruiter license to reinvite candidates.
---
# Reinviting candidates to a test

To reinvite a candidate to a test:

1.  Log in to your **HackerRank for Work** account using your credentials.

2.  Go to the **Tests** tab. 

3.  Open the test from which you want to reinvite candidates.

4.  Go to the **Candidates** tab.

5.  Select the checkbox next to the candidate you want to reinvite.

    ![image.png](https://assets.usepylon.com/e6a58e21-be80-4777-9eaf-f73beeee94d9%2F1763973867880-image.png?Expires=253370764800&Signature=EhTgCO-3LdCNjy~j1vEOHiY1aDE8V9d271Qb-nhPMXoDPshDCicK1N0r4xZAqFeLfgNehT1Ic89bV6pgieDeRZO-R5~unlKJ9XUYU3A~8m9vMAdt5nX58xAZpsb6jtJNgbY~DZASH7sCjT9gYxKCARG6THYQDAUJp5tOpRxJle7kp4FpPtelaew6j6QZRWEj9zWL0cUu~mQxNWpqBoibi6FXGnN3ZdR1pvYSlNVf5tIQH5d5GjNp8yfKDRe6Qkk~8n7x68cOOoDdF1jeba1ufwoFwQkAO60q-IWVhI6Zj3PRrEvEiUlXdjmQLiXLTgZF8P8se-BFWB8Ti3653qBitQ__&Key-Pair-Id=K3NV4LZ47N8M46)

6.  Click **Invite selected**.

    ![image.png](https://assets.usepylon.com/e6a58e21-be80-4777-9eaf-f73beeee94d9%2F1763973811595-image.png?Expires=253370764800&Signature=ksQG-IGnoQ9EPBFb~iBVdB3zGok5kUppbBPdTdiaLWtYuDirbO2Y33Q8fygODVvKHlrGcUJHy0ekSYf4OXgDqponJQ~XrOc8rrLghFgee9IwIeXp3CDdx7aiuxcdJ4DywlMQxPe2yAMeEkpTd91X6hCFkXrEhl95TVFWSPDWX0ZON7sxRZrQOTMWSMADBKONNB4X2KvoQcPnvTA4xbZQzvaLVGRNK9MVuvmEcxj7~OVtyMEns6XNypDb~fmUhhIJhsiUST1kRUnGaP3DRrIZf-1zXlPy7Is7fwYE4IUKWw-tX0R48dzi34OYmie0dLm95xqfrtctYwKPBUurriklFQ__&Key-Pair-Id=K3NV4LZ47N8M46)

# Deleting an Email Template

_Last updated: Dec 24, 2024, 4:28 PM (Last updated 1 year ago)_
---
## Overview

Once created, you can delete an existing Email Invite Template if you no longer require it. This article will walk you through the steps to delete the existing Email Invite Template. 

**Note**: You can only delete your Templates. A Shared Template can only be deleted by the HackerRank Recruiter who has created the Template.
---
## Steps to Delete an Email Invite Template

**Prerequisites**

1.  You must have created an email template that you want to delete.\
    \

**Steps**

1.  Navigate to the **Tests **tab on the HackerRank for Work homepage, and then click on the **Invite **icon on the extreme right.

    ![Sending_Bulk_Invite_-_Invite.jpg](https://assets.usepylon.com/e6a58e21-be80-4777-9eaf-f73beeee94d9%2F1734046618492-?Expires=253370764800&Signature=VDlMcBd9fZeRHHIgIwptVjkVnD63ksJa1RYc7-SssnYx-LTsMWX6-RJYxfIXrqN9krPMkvRhDSlrgfqsFvbArfaEY2vjX7VOph-lhMW4dHC8N1Lt6h~tIMaz-ktrjfCKIhfGehx6XkxpyaYEH21V9elD3QU792qXXIjRYAFAtGWsQq1jMJfPnVkYdTVwZB1f3VWKmVL7GCr66bwGKmdNope1eBN4tMITSP4ehxfm9RlHdyiEgNfLW3E7nbQJxsJcNd~YW-jfqkIyeWH1Ok9ufpcN5FxYUm8kDx3FzRlFpKgkXJXTY6waLIC20~Um5OKzZXE4SZHLPlVc8hXiZejS4Q__&Key-Pair-Id=K3NV4LZ47N8M46)

*The Invite option to invite Candidates for a Test*

1.   The Send Test Invites page is displayed.

![Creating_an_Email_Template_-_Template_Save.jpg](https://assets.usepylon.com/e6a58e21-be80-4777-9eaf-f73beeee94d9%2F1734046618807-?Expires=253370764800&Signature=W4n-0mr26oHkJP61LwX3Y5sx1d5SFSdN88Xky6-4uqYkFyq~DE85VEJ7PjSjY1YKDGcdua~nn1JkoqXAsWEG6m8GuNLGPi7rhY6lUQJ4neNTT9FlOan-R2wCfFcCy2WnfPxU9bVifOERAvRBTeA1fyonnZheAe4nEuNPLT1o4SmSy4EfcKDSrj~ngdn9HJgEeO4gvXSPpSqoGpHwNTKDHsl3WRXRkQ2D1Up6kmgE82Zj-SlbDnLoWy0lUdd9Q0EcMP7~4U3sm3BHYhEgEM63pQuPXeY08Cbo4w8qRXY2yenemckMYcDLPwYPGuOJCZdeSiN-qIDNhCRqymsNAGCyyg__&Key-Pair-Id=K3NV4LZ47N8M46)

*The 'Send Test Invites" page*

1.  Click on the **Templates** icon. The Templates window is displayed. Your Templates are listed under **My Templates**, and the ones created by other Recruiters in your HackerRank Team are listed under **Shared Templates**.

2.  From the **My Templates** list, select the Template you want to delete.

3.  Click on the **Delete Template** icon in the right pane. The Template is deleted.

    ![Deleting_an_Email_Invite_-_Delete.jpg](https://assets.usepylon.com/e6a58e21-be80-4777-9eaf-f73beeee94d9%2F1734046619209-?Expires=253370764800&Signature=KySqGo6tjbCDClkqfSMIQfotQigmMQTZOeyuDYc7U81RwreTLD2zj0PzbrMsNwSwVCLcKam~eN9Rqree4Qe1nIWFBx7MpuLGsSeABlGB7ta1T-3S4r0skRP6XkNZm4Ke8CfamIVy87bT2bYLXaS7QSCxPBcTb1UIZ7YIs0wt-v8PbN9n~jNVDiVcwnz6EONvWRj~Pmt3VYPYjy-i~dZGjLHwbToW2zwPv1YsFZsJj~eNgEyIm0s8OgtpDa-k0aGEefoyIte22xeUkSqMpN~CnJyiHjsr4-19wCfMPfHwQKH2AVkSCXUIqWpw1H8pN9XVcfkmTF3vWoq9rMUmuVHb5Q__&Key-Pair-Id=K3NV4LZ47N8M46)

*Deleting a Template*

1.  You are prompted to undo the delete operation if required. Click on the **Undo** option to retrieve the Template.

# Limitations With HackerRank Projects

_Last updated: Oct 22, 2025, 9:18 PM (Last updated 6 months ago)_

The project questions on HackerRank use VM-based containers, with specific limitations on the number of workspaces a company can have at any given time. 

**Limitations by Question Type:**

- **Logins per Minute:**  The maximum number of candidates who can log into a test from a company in any given minute.

- **Workspace:** A container assigned to a project question. Each project question uses one independent workspace.

- **Concurrent Workspaces:**  The total number of containers a company can utilize simultaneously.

**Example**

If a test includes two project questions:

- **Maximum Logins**: 50 candidate logins per minute.

- **Simultaneous Test takers**: Up to 500 candidates. 

- **Concurrent Workspaces**: 1000 concurrent workspaces (each candidate will utilize two workspaces (one for each project question)
---
## Candidate Experience 

Generally, candidates can log in without any issues. However, if the limits are exceeded, they will experience the following when:

**1. Logins per Minute are at Capacity:** When login capacity is reached, candidates will see a message indicating their login is temporarily throttled. A countdown will replace the "**Try Again**" button, and candidates will be provisioned on servers once it finishes.

![Confirmation Form.png](https://assets.usepylon.com/e6a58e21-be80-4777-9eaf-f73beeee94d9%2F1734046700429-?Expires=253370764800&Signature=gAI0fmDcO5PJrv0f5Fhv78bbOwRMy9YKgIFWSQCnsNZNHE0~~EfbsMf2p3h0AJqBemuKg9JN88W9WDSgoiJRhrQeGzXJbHRE~p~peIJa4Kz-rhV1OJd5G5n9gNkbZr4JjrejHOK-gvFtS92GHm71j37Yj14ju5ExZz7B44~Bg10o1kWl~jB1H~J7L-ZmaGHdDROTOw1-1CzYml~~CsHNP39xyo6aHhUT4eSFbdbeLRNqREx-1fo6eQEAsBqT8eTn5N2XLfrJjaXSZVpzDrlzs8EH1hGQ~pAYi~1A1vNGDvBZRr~WieHHbrBhPlaKcAqFQCym8vkmwEg-Iwxl97B7nw__&Key-Pair-Id=K3NV4LZ47N8M46)

**2. Concurrent Workspaces are at Capacity:** If the concurrent workspace limit is exceeded, the remaining candidates will see an error message: "Our servers are at capacity. Please try to take this test after some time." As candidates complete their attempts, new candidates will be allowed to log in.

![Servers at capacity.png](https://assets.usepylon.com/e6a58e21-be80-4777-9eaf-f73beeee94d9%2F1734046700808-?Expires=253370764800&Signature=Gxi18p7-iXxnJWK~06OCeL6hamhgxRilpfENgVrjjjlP-q3YECFphF6fSm5zhuA16N2d3-ilesyJnNpA-xI5kzlmdOG9wi~gzoXY66sAAQjqyDJMkCgswe~cyYY0NS3K00r2KDbsVj6yiyDProKp1ZJD-E7L8LLT~6W4fM2~bDNrUyniTftodOCC3gZZG9D1MCazLB57IJ6zync6IBq8TG0X1VZ3QTgurvC7EkTzEpwRgfwik6SQGnJg3usd~Kr4My9lhkO~5lqifZ8K4FCTroJ1m-MAqh-spu-8I1J2IrQvdAhRAtRoXTBvzH8XYlCQvQGcF9vJoN0m~t5EXC3rAQ__&Key-Pair-Id=K3NV4LZ47N8M46)

**Note:**

- Reach out to [support@hackerrank.com](mailto:support@hackerrank.com) if your requirement exceeds the default threshold. Given the limitations, inviting candidates in batches to stagger logins is recommended. Also, the limits remain the same irrespective of the test duration, as the table above mentions.

- For both Project questions and non-project questions, if the requirement is more than 5,000 simultaneous attempts, reach out to [support@hackerrank.com](mailto:support@hackerrank.com).

# Using Shared Email Templates

_Last updated: Jan 20, 2025, 1:05 PM (Last updated 1 year ago)_

\

Recruiters belonging to different HackerRank Teams can share and reuse email invite Templates. Assuming that you are one of many recruiters in HackerRank, email invite templates created by you and all other recruiters can be shared and reused by all the members.
---
## How to Share Email Invite Templates

**Prerequisites**

1.  At least one email Template must be created by you or other Recruiters in HackerRank.

**Steps**

1.  Navigate to the **Tests** tab. For the selected Test, click the **Invite** icon on the extreme right. The **Send Test Invites** page is displayed. If you have set a default email Template, the email editor automatically populates the editor with the default Template format.

2.  Click on the **Templates** icon—the Template window displays.

3.  Templates created by you are listed under the **My Templates** tab, and the ones created by other Recruiters in HackerRank are listed under the **Shared Templates** tab.

    ![Creating_an_Email_Template_-_My_Template.jpg](https://assets.usepylon.com/e6a58e21-be80-4777-9eaf-f73beeee94d9%2F1734046689349-?Expires=253370764800&Signature=B5KM-7YXraozFGsXLRUviBs~W3HHFZIOOjHVijJVQg1qnr2-inCQ3rj8shJMbk1P9OihiBkjWZ9OdQ4eOxBsooO28m9tDtk3XFkzQ5Nv~sxHs-xivj8HIYbIiPEuplns2k3a8~wSYSzSoVSTjXPvuLNhLwRDqraIZmUedA4j21DiRptvMJTHmLYPJGTYPgssoHoMJWXen8tPc4XtXl1mDkX3W6i0Q2WHzld7AHiD3QnMrANjbkgSQxJIZvsyJaKqYNONWArFd9AStpPBKpz4kJeov7rUUOqld9BZdG7cnmuYJDGrpHyEGqqWcu2vdZd55ljmN009o3Ob5w~2WOrU7g__&Key-Pair-Id=K3NV4LZ47N8M46)

![Shared_Invite_-_Shared.jpg](https://assets.usepylon.com/e6a58e21-be80-4777-9eaf-f73beeee94d9%2F1734046689688-?Expires=253370764800&Signature=hpgTP-ReilY-RAWEZAuOkvcXdjNZ6VKRh-DHsWHt0McXRtedIlMPH-WPTvwZZZvW8CLLSi3x3-aGQ4Qq1YJOqa8PDdYWksd4dyJPo2gQcvWXTVyQvvUi~P8GQvoI84YCOgNwC37h7O7j6ZrkPiJMWVoRpHtMGN~XgMCEHkMzfja7BOBVc-hkoezInZPhmsqIhAMiZ1yKD3Ij~oXaJ4uZ4hp9Vs7kZl0OYuv6abYQI8ZhqtNWIcC1qKdaJX11g8b8apIfXDSfuGLYQW~~nYMVr3qZ9JP70EWI9cHLswIOLte5IwSIbjyOdJqSan4jedfr2akYSfmDNCObg~sTODgQwQ__&Key-Pair-Id=K3NV4LZ47N8M46)

*The ‘Shared Templates’ List*

1.  Click on the **Shared Templates** list. The list of all Templates created by your HackerRank Team is displayed. The HackerRank email account displayed below each Template name indicates the owner of the shared Template. You can use the **search** bar to search from the list of Templates.

2.  Select a Template in the list to preview the contents.

3.  Click the **Use this Template** button, to use the selected format in your email invite.
---
## Creating Your Own Template From a Shared Template

You can copy a Shared Template format into a new template. All the contents from the shared Template will be copied, and your Template will be listed under “**My Templates**.”

To copy the format from a Shared Template to a new Template:

1.  In the **Shared Templates** list, select a Template whose format and contents you want to copy into a new Template of your own.

2.  In the right pane, edit the name of the template, or make changes in the Subject or contents.

    ![Shared_Invite_-_Edit.jpg](https://assets.usepylon.com/e6a58e21-be80-4777-9eaf-f73beeee94d9%2F1734046689998-?Expires=253370764800&Signature=FtPrKghI~-BSttn7ltwuniomznaIjmWst2NuMJCGAj-FyD99dWz4LRQXjyfypVOLkXSyAF3ap9iY7qrvuR79BpToDRCINeBqZsEkUGmq3VuP1RrLyvPtn~TYsc1~pXmFjtNd4FenfhYtiItO9Zy9HTq1YZKv1JsQwjwQ2AiTtUnHAAI7lznN~eTXxNIeJ97lYNVdSdV8vZTOHnysNdq7FWSJ9gF61vZnje3lAopQFZb4B1uBYvR3Uj65W5hCLNZppXij7gjbI8xpCHe5r5lE~LQwOagxDc-DshFXMFQBY119XfLAps1GVCJPIGS5~w8WsanUjXETOBj972TdH7JY9A__&Key-Pair-Id=K3NV4LZ47N8M46)

3\. Click on the **Save** button.

4\. A copy of the Shared Template is created and listed under the **My Templates** tab.  Click the **Use this Template** button to use this format in your email invite.

![Shared_Invite_-_My_temp.jpg](https://assets.usepylon.com/e6a58e21-be80-4777-9eaf-f73beeee94d9%2F1734046690320-?Expires=253370764800&Signature=E9NLSsUx1MehhsKukq~GqWQAfvr3AzZaRGf5mt411hIcav5LlXunaRMi0mP5-BpK8RJZJc5wvKgwi3dUQv5vaIrvYVh9AicHTfDt6KAj94zdwUye4vO7MSecRrbLzSyxbB5jWWAmIAoTPdC6exPlkDBf05oNx5XbwNpJaQdKCkM0KRBh1P~99NQZvPLOAoBIO-YllK9HUneKHmTn-ORGyOAAerfL7AmCFycLa~Lldhz5dBQIJlmmQZIOM0Ic8FVYpol9AF3FvL8QriahQQISIqEc3jnbvTnfYvTT7ZV37kAbLLwNcEX4WtkGGDj~vuTwnqGgH03t1~Q-sEycDrEaKw__&Key-Pair-Id=K3NV4LZ47N8M46)

You can also set a Template as the default format for all your email invites.

Refer to the [Using a Custom Email Invite Template](https://kb.hackerrank.com/articles/6675460135-using-a-custom-email-invite-template) article for more information.

# Invite Candidates to a Test Prerequisites Inviting candidates to a test

_Last updated: Jan 28, 2026, 9:52 AM (Last updated 3 months ago)_

HackerRank for Work allows recruiters to invite candidates to take a test. Test invitations are sent via email, including a link to the test and other necessary details. You can customize your email invitations and save them as templates. 

**Note:** You must have a Recruiter license to invite candidates. Hiring managers must request their recruiters to send invitations to the candidates.
---
# Prerequisites

You must have created and published the test for which you want to invite candidates.
---
# Inviting candidates to a test

To invite candidates to a test:

1.  Log in to your **HackerRank for Work** account using your credentials.

2.  Go to the **Tests** tab.

3.  Open the test from which you want to invite candidates.

4.  Click **Invite** in the upper-right corner to open the **Send Test Invites** page.

    ![image.png](https://assets.usepylon.com/e6a58e21-be80-4777-9eaf-f73beeee94d9%2F1746783191607-image.png?Expires=253370764800&Signature=nTJ8SofVL4SdeAORfa7N4ByNt9Xgwg~LJbiKe1JT1LeQ9oAoub~pDme~SNy9ELVh093M1hleCfQFp6oOJBj1QpMli-4WcELaASDrWnxZz18DVvllMvmrrn8t9zF1YCfhrlUkIA~YMycZmQwr~cjdTWvxgCU0azhFCQDTgECMBfO9cTEXLJWVpowIjSX863h2VnnAwsZGCFTcM29Bmt7Fl8UxuyNA8sC5HdvpmW37zweknKeUMdTxH3gOIOQGzuZvGmjUGckBBh9awf7s3eTMVZQCkmyCJytCbD54HzrlrCiB87M3sJG7XTEZK1yDAREQfE9CDEZXJSlcPV~~i9AADQ__&Key-Pair-Id=K3NV4LZ47N8M46)

5.  Enter the candidates’ email addresses in the **To** field. Use either of the following formats:

    ![image.png](https://assets.usepylon.com/e6a58e21-be80-4777-9eaf-f73beeee94d9%2F1746783357664-image.png?Expires=253370764800&Signature=crB64tmC2MRDloX2MD5N5kNaA-QEyIduu9PRQnp~3x4D182sAx2bXAdJ3VwTjuRxByvebaE-8mC9YJngdm3WrGIRRM2Bc9IoBRNeUx7rcidQA-~yjlNFfR3wWHwvzpNzwkQH253LXRa~mO-MdSOe1ogYO485bTsiYmOYioiHgnXflKw7qKZJ9iTmlr8zXkvWAesIomlvGV2yiNR09DxtR8ScGXHO2UnnInAmFbMz~Eo1ckLWg3vlPh4M51GNAO7X9L8VRO~acnYWtXf2Rnyb~fh3UqReQTH8EyiXkDKhcLaFsghm-NAPJyRGKFJ6~OLkex3-fc14WfkajIJlgXrx7A__&Key-Pair-Id=K3NV4LZ47N8M46)

    - **Only email addresses:** [evanbrown@gmail.com](mailto:evanbrown@gmail.com), [ethanv@gmail.com](mailto:ethanv@gmail.com), [nancysmith@outlook.com](mailto:nancysmith@outlook.com)

    - **Names and email addresses:** Evan Brown \<[evanbrown@gmail.com](mailto:evanbrown@gmail.com)\>, Ethan \<[ethanv@gmail.com](mailto:ethanv@gmail.com)\>, Nancy Smith \<[nancysmith@outlook.com](mailto:nancysmith@outlook.com)\>

**Note:** Refer to[📄 Send Bulk Email Invites](/articles/7127221409)to invite many candidates to a test at once using a CSV file

1.  Edit the subject line if necessary. By default, the test name appears as the subject.

    **Note:** You can also include emojis in the subject line.

2.  Customize the email body as needed. Use the formatting options to add bullet points, numbered lists, or other elements.

    ![image.png](https://assets.usepylon.com/e6a58e21-be80-4777-9eaf-f73beeee94d9%2F1746783438273-image.png?Expires=253370764800&Signature=qW0zI1r-tzR4Lh~RKKOSm2-Uui6kLEBfZ9X9~TMMhGt846wJ2WQe6wL1Ji-j3xWJJcdYCmBrtpzazK7IMh0djb1vo00sOOAgogDs220MQLrRVZsFhkqPQSihOESYsJVZvEQUpZU1nJzj6LQrIMfC5U6~iJejGz6cwcIx7YLRy3wftg6QZqkbhlUR7mV8C3Wq39RCjlgbNg4PO8cfX4D0no3b7nRmth8sEMt0OoHEdGpF4ROX2WML7otxkjsehvAQjd45dkjTA~2i05YaJgBpl03jlESqJFMLquGZfNdsimmaKnQpobteS6-by~a5-DGH65HgDxtdZVVDq0PZ~J9S3g__&Key-Pair-Id=K3NV4LZ47N8M46)

**Note:** You can save the email as a template or use an existing template. For more information, see [📄 Using a Custom Email Template](/articles/6675460135)<u>.</u>

1.  Click the **+** icon to insert placeholders for the **Candidate Name** and **Recruiter Name**.

    ![image.png](https://assets.usepylon.com/e6a58e21-be80-4777-9eaf-f73beeee94d9%2F1746783506292-image.png?Expires=253370764800&Signature=NMKPCKI74Sg7VHHlcPuZ0GB91wWHp5ZQoX68HL09l9RcUiB9AKn9Xz-G5j379obFnyMr0RzFiALDSlYMPzp4OEJcDz0MMJNpr7FJK5qkA0aEtX6dVcUfNbD48fnJDkDCFWEC-kbH63F3mHuKoTEK3VdnGRC7Qksf7BqrzZaba6Auoxrpht9LYhsd4sveXeUHXzevXNELdgk3cCab5Y1Tk6cymW9~2QvZdLXv2OXO1hjA8KgRwouTpdZjIMkVhdJqyRhQsA0b~tBb5h2jxGOjsILzQvVKwdjL9L7QhDChfc5NmWA~v-GNFtXMyDj5~GWyDJfU5hDp~OlP3t1OBN5buQ__&Key-Pair-Id=K3NV4LZ47N8M46)

    1.  If the candidate’s name is available, the **Candidate Name** placeholder will display the name from the **To** field or the bulk upload CSV file.

        - **Example:** If the **To** field contains Evan Brown \<[evanbrown@gmail.com](mailto:evanbrown@gmail.com)\>, the placeholder will display Evan Brown when the invite is sent.

    2.  The **Recruiter Name** placeholder will display your full name as registered in your HackerRank account.

<!-- -->

1.  Add a hyperlink or upload a document:

    1.  Click the link icon.

        ![image.png](https://assets.usepylon.com/e6a58e21-be80-4777-9eaf-f73beeee94d9%2F1746783539562-image.png?Expires=253370764800&Signature=M0h16YsDp52TM~USLBfcT~r8d9CVtRtCDI5IMKZnkPGfwwAMxCVUy8SewkDuQ9UHLG-EPS~kpzldnQzVKs7IxEuqRsfEkEdDCktacDoyy40H1ogyepDv2dzFsRSkNesvbcDPktg1mZ-L3DlFMAWMUe2pDKqwx0NSbQAPfDnGOH09XtOw1455uxbrRaUZ5sj9dfvZIs8zYHXuSFsu2jcjwtpX45j9wzfdPXO3CMbcMLv9U4luLMOfqrDYynqGNo3QT0r92rvsvzPKX-KYTo7~1K4eK5A~o3svoZBRzaWBwZlJHbLyYms4cLj9vAW~w1Ne36~2NYc7o9D7hyA1EDqj2w__&Key-Pair-Id=K3NV4LZ47N8M46)

    2.  In the **Add Link** dialog box, enter the display text and URL, or upload a document.

<!-- -->

1.  (Optional) Customize the test invite with additional options:

    - [Set an expiry date](https://support.hackerrank.com/articles/6027855406-inviting-candidates-to-a-test#set-an-expiry-date-14)

    - [Send reminders](https://support.hackerrank.com/articles/6027855406-inviting-candidates-to-a-test#send-reminders-22)

    - [Add time accommodation](https://support.hackerrank.com/articles/6027855406-inviting-candidates-to-a-test#add-time-accommodation-28)

    - [Configure invite settings](https://support.hackerrank.com/articles/6027855406-inviting-candidates-to-a-test#configure-invite-settings-30)

2.  Click **Send Invites**.

**Note: **

- For more information about email invitation best practices, see [📄 Best Practices for Email Delivery and Bounce Management](/articles/1258426835)<u>.</u>

- You can invite a candidate to a test from the **Active Tests** tab by clicking the invite icon next to the test title.

  ![image.png](https://assets.usepylon.com/e6a58e21-be80-4777-9eaf-f73beeee94d9%2F1758612410511-image.png?Expires=253370764800&Signature=DH2xRtb7xF5GplpvfIARxOLYkpEyJ42gjRGhqUq0LMFZWW40nBZAPznssKbb-sqBq01zBR-FFI8pkka8WbF5hHhfkVlYCdkGnTi-GZRRDKlNXegGk~39bU11S6sgDTyXzdrfP2ua9CDYj-gYrJ9okEXfS8EUnOOkMRQBMdsQnLjDnCdtTLB7TaNqP01Mg74dMqM2yCphWSU4Jy7Dnj30ddH9JMQ6CeCsqd2whO1sS3MRR2r55NOGoD9cDchSWBI3ajly1j6eGMLwYTPjmol1cPzWS3gZYEYS8NxBLQ-akUC-pH9As-~B-gnkpc~twlnqodJf9bPta7DH-mBgLL5vFw__&Key-Pair-Id=K3NV4LZ47N8M46)

## Set an expiry date

You can define how long a test invitation remains active. After the expiry time, the test invitation expires, and candidate(s) can no longer take the Test. 

To set the expiration date: 

![image.png](https://assets.usepylon.com/e6a58e21-be80-4777-9eaf-f73beeee94d9%2F1758612369930-image.png?Expires=253370764800&Signature=bR50ftF--6l7XUNLXRkxs1msYksy12GUMgZauXnVk0eAhfZKy7YXh6EyJG0e08SWabaREHOSpvvcBR39V4MiP5TYPjXLcHhKhC9BssivTfUu~e3ynyK1~4aOvgAOIOrlkWpVkP~pw-Wlfvwoh5-s6-WAtx09tbipT2oHh4WBuckTQKJWCkj6x~t7l9Eyv7YWYU~Dgq3AAs3-qv60fmf73OUzVM8qNmWrYRmEyMPW1rUUliQBG3y2O-mNcadymnaec6RSYnCdETG0~qc~vMP4RwFOXHb6Nz4lXmP1XdoDdME5J6cfSPqpGrs0pan9I~eicQfMgVSVsjki3uBPA9E6EA__&Key-Pair-Id=K3NV4LZ47N8M46)

1.  Click the **Expiry** dropdown.

2.  Select an expiry option from the list.

    - If you choose **Custom**, select the expiry date, time, and time zone, and then click **Save.**

      ![image.png](https://assets.usepylon.com/e6a58e21-be80-4777-9eaf-f73beeee94d9%2F1758612341785-image.png?Expires=253370764800&Signature=Ng3yEkJAyCRmtnyfqglbe7gO6~Hmp80~JYR-KM3ck6fwJ7L8OsLHP9jrYI0-Pakad43PwZ~dityyqENKGYxwQpbxzH1Xb6uKXwp2sjxcJtJCaZJRkEtsum8tlwfEhsjoKp4uvLqOp~WOtA9f5r7DPJZ-c9-zrm77Vt9PrIEK~krqYZpbGW0iinhxhRVX4Q2QdZCUKXmuYTuyBzCplSflG6fmHWYgVtUIOj4D0SAZlSA7oUeOeKf122fuGZwstMie9Y1~OribTARZiObGD0ScNtxZphBHuDPiyFjnI2eEccfiUQidQoQQwIQAEI~25LHS6CfS~2T6HZ7pvWNKy7T-~Q__&Key-Pair-Id=K3NV4LZ47N8M46)

The selected expiry date appears.

![image.png](https://assets.usepylon.com/e6a58e21-be80-4777-9eaf-f73beeee94d9%2F1758612586423-image.png?Expires=253370764800&Signature=C0yG2uq5FcGuTOKxujta3rb24ei762V7sAq8W1h64sQ7bL2WheTEKW0U2u-z4lDRs19F~bLkXO0jDn-Epfqe3Z7gnA~U4WDw6BrUeq2Hwar5YJi1Id99fvtAuB36WEBLMpxeWbfrdHL5atw1HBCs2-c3t8InRjIvuhCAgtfeqz4MBcteylu0Qj-7Ko5NcrNwtiNkAaKhgUae9PE6ScLZ0Pk-QD3s6QGd0ZlgdAl0E~JYe3o7vZRHv3HiafZDGMtzBhQcATJ7q-42R0IzdzGXpq-3ZWT8j4Ean~rzZ9C~BNDUm~yuiayan3n44eCgFSukFs5W~bt-Qm2H2rOGq2V21A__&Key-Pair-Id=K3NV4LZ47N8M46)

**Note:** By default, the **Expiry** option is set to **Never**, and the invitation does not expire.

## Send reminders

You can schedule reminder emails for candidates who have not started the test. The steps vary depending on whether the invitation has an expiry date.

![image.png](https://assets.usepylon.com/e6a58e21-be80-4777-9eaf-f73beeee94d9%2F1758612265911-image.png?Expires=253370764800&Signature=TiV04HOta1Ql~CxOAEJSROEl4FWBqUuJ0aU9gZiMxdGIJ3r6MM2PE8vrhgOIvajA4LIFGUGoKzweki4miwa9IjOsOV0bg-aI0ipL~J34tKErM1XFJQGPMXnLTah-6SKLcr8i8SXDxA4fO173Es7rtmCjbOZywcuVhROBMjSavtimEnRtBwVTuhGP5ZQBnyXrYT~SixR0R8yrQTp6RAbYohSPmYkpV4S7Aro7U31ZBfs4X1fzd2fhdLJSuvBTBl6NNwN7XvkLidjyQQPGY5HzVKnH4eNbMpn0NzASU~pnnpymCr-h1wvdOFbtqEwOlJDGy-vZY~bJ5AY4a7gBNnGVyA__&Key-Pair-Id=K3NV4LZ47N8M46)

- **Expiry is set to Never**:\
  To set a reminder:

  1.  Click the **Send Reminder** dropdown.

  2.  Select a reminder duration from the list.

      - If you choose **Custom**, enter the number of days after the invitation is sent and then click **Save**.

        ![image.png](https://assets.usepylon.com/e6a58e21-be80-4777-9eaf-f73beeee94d9%2F1758612232757-image.png?Expires=253370764800&Signature=Ji7qwgmEv3zNwt4JBo5h21MlIJ1q96x5Ht3nIfeVWJ-LNWaUbsTDz1A2vnYURYB2gft9zdV0PirBc0F6sommZJjEbh-1VG5BsS6YrvQcRDGzmab7CSK9vlLd1tlDIyqbwnJVnb-yMUf2t5CSjqRL6NG9W~5l3QhfWoecFkgpxjqyqkskztMRGaBROyzZMA8Eqlc5kjVSHWN8hckXGdIhbQIGXu8lxyMYMVhaypqqpbyLIe6~e-Ts1WBsyodDCe2FmYfJE4zaUsPBUMuuUD3LkNK7apVF6FZYUwMYTHAUTnggu0SWmoT3CzBVfLD0eMDYPtgD5UeI~4FWMWgr9y70Rw__&Key-Pair-Id=K3NV4LZ47N8M46)

<!-- -->

- **Expiry is set to a specific date:**\
  To set a reminder:

  1.  Click the **Send Reminder** dropdown.

  2.  Select a reminder duration from the list.

      - If you choose **Custom**, enter the number of days before the invitation expires and then click **Save**.

        ![image.png](https://assets.usepylon.com/e6a58e21-be80-4777-9eaf-f73beeee94d9%2F1758612179243-image.png?Expires=253370764800&Signature=jcaMxJlVdQMhgGAfDyFGIO-dGhTqMLPjOyqZmRgUWG3VkiXFY1tCXiHf2aLaBpfxtefQIkhDsE2TGp8APfV6yXAZDxrb5M4AYcTObguHBgFpGAOxRnc9CURD3YvBpwUMwd25IjoMffMqZOq1eHP3bvgnBnn-gVySVM5Nr4ibhb4zrzhbHitk5aoDDBRCamU3X6osh9XEH1qhT2EdJjfDX79s4rMxM4t5875NIVAVE~qOnkQYx2KuLrJqwcoVswfTS7rBAsqulJF8CJa86z3fqF4qADROAwSTeYd8SHR429XUmRrBBXG~NkzAfv~Ru7jfVmFfuKCR3uJSnY4yIPZL6w__&Key-Pair-Id=K3NV4LZ47N8M46)

**Note:** Reminder emails are only sent to candidates who have not started the Test. Reminders can be scheduled only if the invitation expires more than one day from today.

## Add time accommodation

You can extend the test duration if needed. For more information, see [📄 Extend Test Duration for Candidates](/articles/4811403281).
---
## Configure invite settings

You can configure additional email options for test invitation, such as sending a copy to yourself, including the test link, displaying start and end dates, and adding candidate tags. 

To configure the settings:

![image.png](https://assets.usepylon.com/e6a58e21-be80-4777-9eaf-f73beeee94d9%2F1758612127733-image.png?Expires=253370764800&Signature=CfdTxXATlc2maxAOLomLg-oLZ2Rj3FZ7wuahksULYoOVnVGD-J9Nop215wqv-BsxBMS0zQCbaKHxD7Uoxz7P01zebVMvZNtpNm30U9EoIr7eKTfS3mmbq~3c7x90mNrtB-pKXI3h~NPLG2PbAGZYUiog0aW77LATN0RU8f20w1Jsh8p1nrQGtGBDvMUkW06P6XwjwJq0WHNfxQJbYntdmvYHdt1rQ6yLk0mK621bNjz-zLkCPMG2rq4Vnwjhfv3bF-~Kc3gs46SvMD4dnKtR~cuWFdH3P~vuj~VQyS2-FjS5XMyAq6-V1BayQEefjAH1ZLLvqupGZRCdn6p-1aVTzQ__&Key-Pair-Id=K3NV4LZ47N8M46)

1.  Click **Settings** in the upper-right corner.

2.  Select the checkboxes for the options you want:

    - **Send a copy to myself:** Receive the same invite email.

    - **Include test link in email:** Add a test link in the candidate’s email.

    - **Include start/end dates in email:** Display the test start and expiry details in the email.

**Note:** **Include test link in email,** and **include start/end dates in email** are selected by default.

1.  Enter tags to associate with the candidate under **Add Tags**. Tags help to search and filter candidates.

# Cancel a Test Invite

_Last updated: May 12, 2025, 4:37 PM (Last updated 12 months ago)_

HackerRank for Work allows you to cancel a test invitation that you have already sent to a candidate.
---
## Prerequisites

- You must have created the test.

- You must have already sent the invitation to the candidate.
---
## Canceling a test invitation

To cancel a test invitation:

1.  Log in to your **HackerRank for Work** account using your credentials.

2.  Go to the **Tests** tab.

3.  Open the test from which you want to cancel a candidate's invitation.

4.  Go to the **Candidates** tab.

    ![image.png](https://assets.usepylon.com/e6a58e21-be80-4777-9eaf-f73beeee94d9%2Fbad8f716-dff4-42e5-9963-72616b9a4ff4-1746782811789-image.png-b7cbe039-2522-4131-903b-c276d4325264?Expires=253370764800&Signature=kRMKC-Gtk34kkgFnL55xZQdcNKvxo072cnZiLNLlZ2Ve8NIpMksP--wEKtMQ7gdtIbPaCa9Axh75FB~3QvqvWt0Wfmhwjqs6j5jn4lsOfdhklKiv9bu9FA8beqTgAp2RfGbMJrCW89Y08-s49I4UWOZjPl8dYZy2x6Y2aaUaV322aprhau~3PL68f4LRdXEJe84UD9sU~UrMoX7QmdLrwGYqsd3zgVkwSn2fOfDfnI-MKYsF~KuZTu04-Ch9GnOT1N-ZuBqd6RBR4KlCD-gh603P6YIKrWYGVoYblSyJC72usDC9hWuSyaaRvcA4zUSk~LgLEWRteXTGLbJBZq6XKw__&Key-Pair-Id=K3NV4LZ47N8M46)

5.  Select the checkbox next to the candidate’s email address.

**Note:** You can select one or more candidates.

1.  Click **More** \> **Cancel Invite**.

    ![image.png](https://assets.usepylon.com/e6a58e21-be80-4777-9eaf-f73beeee94d9%2F571ed502-6938-42c9-8cdf-02bc2e8d5d70-1747047708588-image.png-fe89a736-ec06-4ac4-93f7-a24d72e2b8eb?Expires=253370764800&Signature=hoTLg~OtGvE1ccJjNs~lOv6pHYjrNjPqK8KZnETS7Z08rW9I3QBL8sJt3zY05e5CYutTz4VLksIPpizuZuaEJheEs1gtsNPEaBU1Oy0T3JCBUOM2PAALGWeyAQxxfwMxA--WxnneutzNImgoJrmz66d4ibeL0~KxAYocBnUiPv7LRBjBfgcff2hCTa0Sz3L1cZ3MsmmHcSiUblfE~ickD8JnS72b9sbJ3cQD1M1ugOGU1HiEozCNFUV70-ARTPuYm48cI7YSQLPap~4D-nfBoEGExOHuELEM2Tym1LI2pwe7CzkkK7NLqWyGP8XaHNukSqkBalAkTkIEFhtlR0sxDg__&Key-Pair-Id=K3NV4LZ47N8M46)

The candidate(s) will be removed from the test’s invitation list. The number of canceled invitations is credited back to your company’s account.
---
## Candidate experience

Canceled candidates can no longer access the test. If they attempt to start the test, an error message is displayed.

![test.png](https://assets.usepylon.com/e6a58e21-be80-4777-9eaf-f73beeee94d9%2F38771ff3-2401-4af5-93b3-864096e1d475-1747047816106-test.png-4ccfc67c-5f00-4eec-873e-837c81dddb87?Expires=253370764800&Signature=rSAEjseUK-nqC4MKO~0LGKwaGZA26vEid601MnPlpDFvPhOswBmWRwRFoIsXVgXtVGJ17f9~YFqdXWfQ1rfIPujazn7dx5lqZ4YSNJSeYfk2BuqLPHVqjw2qWpwllq8HisHWGlZ459M3~ShZuW~rYnxHxxm4YZDrXseOUaxQ92w-Pda1eoRNXO4YrCzE0N6LcZ90itlsCwMPYQH45wWwJjBAy5Ia5X7oo~SbGeckgmV8rKMQICmlLTgx5EO~8KDVQpcVrDkicNfar7-m2dBevb4Xs7Bthu5CeuRH~Nx8rl2hryY2hyLKQP4Bqq2vou7Gu7Flj4E9Vl~pTrpUIrISCA__&Key-Pair-Id=K3NV4LZ47N8M46)

For more details about inviting candidates, see [📄 Invite Candidates to a Test](/articles/6027855406).

# Send Bulk Email Invites Sending bulk email invites Troubleshooting bulk invite errors

_Last updated: Sep 17, 2025, 12:25 PM (Last updated 7 months ago)_

The Bulk Invite feature allows you to send test invitations to many candidates at once using a CSV file.

- **CSV file requirements:** Before you upload the CSV file, ensure that it meets the following requirements:

  - The file must be in `.csv` format.

  - The maximum file size is 2 MB.

  - The file can contain up to 35,000 rows.

<!-- -->

- **CSV content formats:** You can include only email addresses or both names and email addresses in your CSV file.

  - **Email addresses only:** List candidate email addresses in a single column.\
    For example, `evanbrown@gmail.com`, `nancysmith@gmail.com`.

  - **Names and email addresses:** You can include names with email addresses in one of the following ways:

    - **Inline format**: Enter names with email addresses in the format `Name<email>`.\
      For example, `Evan Brown<evanbrown@gmail.com>`, `Nancy Smith<nancysmith@gmail.com>`.

    - **Separate columns**: Enter names in one column and email addresses in another.

**Note:** If you include candidate names in the CSV file, you can personalize invitations by using the Candidate Name placeholder. The system automatically replaces the placeholder with the candidate’s name from your file.
---

# Troubleshooting bulk invite errors

When you upload a CSV file, the system automatically validates the entries. If the file contains invalid invitations, an error message appears.

![image.png](https://assets.usepylon.com/e6a58e21-be80-4777-9eaf-f73beeee94d9%2F1757401512990-image.png?Expires=253370764800&Signature=aOc4~Jm239OmICxAJ69exN~7ij0HqxiHVgaJKG~BpPcqzfgReXnDtriJJeXCXiiZ7aklDerle5zrsmwhcOzBmpOOdbdQ9AJFQpXTvdtniK5aPxZv71fzUBlQNZVYNk4JmbMfP75LmzHPvnnD5~L~rKIr9F2xFNj52NkwD2dueQvwulFAGV5vewON0W1rFmnO4vUbLn2UCex0X471pE~9LjlTg~16Lqe7lVjf1Qy78gSh-xos~sC-cD2hzJoJQT-f9YPjEP6Tp8C6Zr2aBOaSUmTeGihwdtJKYmeYcW9sVxEQOHNKB7Hrf6Gtx92sAdrDrape~xe51-gbTJXH6Bh7tw__&Key-Pair-Id=K3NV4LZ47N8M46)

Select **Resolve** to view a list of all invalid invites with details such as the number of invalid invites and reasons for invalid email invites.

![image.png](https://assets.usepylon.com/e6a58e21-be80-4777-9eaf-f73beeee94d9%2F1757401535565-image.png?Expires=253370764800&Signature=eo3CbUuhWtWEjqm4Gd4wQ~tTsIhHVQWqxzfAWgaV8vxRGcnVePwc9teq~Vmgp57zCxkpPwQ8HOjHnYleghV9b-TyzB1yy9J5rFPChkXh2VVLFU7Jaz46kYvTzrF80m5ZiZWi8OJyQeBOn6dpIvKJUIsywIV0m9Rv1e67qr-fZgA~lEOiXL1aQsu7H6Tk0cj-RRLFO-iUz7walJcrFyl0qBzBhXbJGM~T401d5Mkm-x2ke04Q5b~rkLmFRwopQjMZ8g4vomCS6YuvH6ymGSWjYOcanldAtWnfTav8h4EfHfafdcqsnof92jLtyLBrBVS-c8tzcpzkmDBhqJjojgFGnw__&Key-Pair-Id=K3NV4LZ47N8M46)

You may encounter the following errors:

- **Previously invited:** Candidates who already received an invitation cannot be included in the CSV upload.\
  To troubleshoot, click **Re-invite** candidates to send another invite, or remove these candidates from the CSV file.

- **Incorrect email structure:** An email address does not follow the correct format.\
  To troubleshoot, correct the email address using a valid format, such as `name@example.com` or `Name<name@example.com>`.

- **Duplicate emails:** The same email address appears more than once in the CSV.\
  To troubleshoot, remove duplicate email addresses from the CSV file before uploading it again.

# Editing an Email Template

_Last updated: Dec 24, 2024, 4:27 PM (Last updated 1 year ago)_
---
## Overview

Once you are done creating the Email invite templates, you can edit your existing email invite Templates to make necessary changes. This article walks you through the steps to edit the existing email invite templates.
---
## Steps to Edit an Email Invite Template

**Prerequisites**

1.  You must have created an email invite Template that you want to edit.

**Steps**

1\. Navigate to the **Tests**. For the selected Test, click on the **Invite** icon on the extreme right. 

![Sending_Bulk_Invite_-_Invite.jpg](https://assets.usepylon.com/e6a58e21-be80-4777-9eaf-f73beeee94d9%2F1734046600632-?Expires=253370764800&Signature=EOTnl86i76gFQljOD-W7E7CQXPu~nq1zGK18AdcJjptVqSTcrprrnGreNW~0-t0U3VTGVv2OLnXetbiePh7raSPpoJY7DNJFuSvoZeWhk0EmMvhzdrwnInp0FBR3KcIkm61WT0Wpm2yL3h1gDEFzgZu9svjMgdtAonKAQoVNxqZ5kh37zyqwTPQbV8m--~UPQgEXgQ~WOKMelLXv8hEb5HnJTBgPMZ7jXVDdtTYNXh9pMWOprGD~nS7fAC6jWIoXmYm55WhaNsGeGs-TTEWKlp~44pF~3yuHPfk1IX6GMSYyeY0vJ1ZR1vSwL7zGCI91wkkMMYI0BmaylPIsaNUNUw__&Key-Pair-Id=K3NV4LZ47N8M46)

*The Invite option to invite Candidates for a Test*

2\. The **Send Test Invites** page is displayed. If you have set a default email Template, the email editor automatically populates the editor with the default Template format.  

![Editing_an_Email_Invite_-_Email_invite.jpg](https://assets.usepylon.com/e6a58e21-be80-4777-9eaf-f73beeee94d9%2F1734046601113-?Expires=253370764800&Signature=ts2sGRNM6tRwGSd3F69uJVq2ts6ReIeBwrEJpBtIh3mxaUg236JZ7OG3OGtp5ReFBi~UgcaWK2fhQVNRrC9hoPZt-Q-Z907QxiH3C6HUbMeXhkCjB-cabd4z-Fpa4X03YoDf~ElP-GqSfLGvuoEx7i4sxdmQS430eemOtUctGvRu1EO~IzxtLW4tCnltoptCKIZDkpBvi4szIgZFhRUfmB68mcsor0PKYmgEVdUcpfCSPBFDyH98LmwTTaw-Tz2vAschfqMJ0RQdCEAcxUCxBpM6KoDlydLf2hY3CK2h5UWn8tmbDSU42HAv0nxZtkxu1F2AZPfyF02nozbSl6Tg8Q__&Key-Pair-Id=K3NV4LZ47N8M46)

*The Send Invites Page - Email Editor*

Refer to the [Using a Custom Email Invite Template](https://support.hackerrank.com/hc/en-us/articles/360010822713-Using-a-Custom-Email-Invite-Template) article for more information.

3\. In the editor, make necessary changes to the email invite. Click on the **Save Templates** icon. The Template window is displayed. The changes made to the email invite are shown.

![Editing_an_Email_Invite_-_Edited.jpg](https://assets.usepylon.com/e6a58e21-be80-4777-9eaf-f73beeee94d9%2F1734046601411-?Expires=253370764800&Signature=CbFN5RJ-KnW42mP~3kK9EInHB6kHo-Wji4qgXP30jWjy9YobMw6rK-2byieMR5MM7XpmnISzdaJWmMiYbIwdOovTA7rITFngsTjQtZvL2fzn0hY5btfIJd~jhqhQr6zw10sSDIvrHs2LATTRQ0QnwkzHE9IXlsZ3G0en8cvgawg9j3EfvrAme-Du676IEYL4GfRYnE5EtpKGNXQdAO4wHDlD5bgWFUDU-zIjTN7Rh6B6g6nWH9kM-xYVMlDXhaAePwdXjEFdUGAQ0Yo52a0nnqfKlJplwIoTz0w7rNJ52DJt46sULL8D0lRHs6CEEyclxJkqfPjCfjQEDJ4xVuQQSw__&Key-Pair-Id=K3NV4LZ47N8M46)

*Editing a Template*

 4. Click on the **Save** button. The Template is updated successfully. 

Alternatively, you can also edit a template from the Template window.

1\. Click on the **Templates** icon. The Templates window displays. Templates created by you are listed under **My Template**, and the ones created by other Recruiters in your HackerRank Team are listed under the **Shared Templates**.

2\. Select the Template you want to edit. In the right pane, make necessary changes.

![Editing_an_Email_Invite_-_Saved.jpg](https://assets.usepylon.com/e6a58e21-be80-4777-9eaf-f73beeee94d9%2F1734046601865-?Expires=253370764800&Signature=UR-HbOjAPuuibXLZLj1clQhoH6mFy4O8TR7jB8va38aN-9Mw1FvuTzzT9fGz41njiZ9Gm~41HRUVAkPFKgKpz1PLXdXMQzENT~SnYkwi8oLsT4D52VS0ht7IWJjmUvV-~vlu21MmPEfAvJmJ9bM8X5h~vWEKfqK8ydjgOBXQ-7FQunJVRW9o00-bG6X7FGvL1euPwLYstR1aWcgAFzlTrZKkildbAYeXUbEZAgSgXX~lYZQxcWrpJn8dU7SWjknQaLtzn76r58Eylx13f2ZNQ8AcQ3D5Orr-6ZbheIx91aM4slyCRV9sHBUAOIRAJBXUv9vSmShEn6chk0OAvoJ6HA__&Key-Pair-Id=K3NV4LZ47N8M46)

*Editing and updating a Template*

 3. Click on the **Save** button. The Template is updated successfully.

# Manage Email Templates Prerequisite Creating a custom email template Editing a custom email template Using a custom email template Using a shared email template Setting a default email template Deleting a custom email template

_Last updated: Jan 28, 2026, 9:51 AM (Last updated 3 months ago)_

Email templates in HackerRank allow you to standardize and streamline candidate communications. You can create, edit, reuse, and share customized email invitation templates with your team to ensure consistent messaging across hiring scenarios.

For example, create one email template for campus hiring and another for lateral hiring. Save each template separately and select the appropriate one when you send invitations.
---
# Prerequisite

You must have a published test in your HackerRank for Work account.
---
# Creating a custom email template

To create a custom email template:

1.  Log in to your **HackerRank for Work** account using your credentials.

2.  Go to the **Tests** tab.

3.  Open a test.

4.  Click **Invite** in the upper-right corner to open the **Send Test Invites** page.

    ![image.png](https://assets.usepylon.com/e6a58e21-be80-4777-9eaf-f73beeee94d9%2F1758792415687-image.png?Expires=253370764800&Signature=NcYRTyHS~MjrZTZ1N8LzHhZPhg4HZ5GPhyAfQJ9OITcsnG2TIW9QquNIrzU2UBF6cbSjp37Kuaa~ki3YDsU1oj~jbo7oIbKj67uGF5y5G9ccN1KuaimFrBar9SeYqoP13ZAJvDa90u6Ha0fndU2t3GA6fAClVcyWR2l3lSvgdVPBHIu2ElNnMCt-zfqyeI-Bx8t2RUKKa12nPVMadbKwjFSbqrP2UVkgaXyElcteNISw1GYD2VYcruQ-~z-Ku5E2RENbW-DStNJjOfUTp2PcUOUUc3vPi~nATEGmkf4AnCb8ZyHUzJGc86jH9ko-tn-dX4lxk17L2hXZGJkZ3P0gKw__&Key-Pair-Id=K3NV4LZ47N8M46)

5.  Click the **Templates** icon.

    ![image.png](https://assets.usepylon.com/e6a58e21-be80-4777-9eaf-f73beeee94d9%2F1758792467720-image.png?Expires=253370764800&Signature=R1AYaJ7XNXxNRSGFeawoGZjajKhRp6c0sUtilLZfP-c4N96foqZ1xPlFbFm974Vf8WkeNNb0naFH2AJgzPbZJ8U9z9kevHGyvG7HlaJEFNCChz04eS4QRUplvUjvIKgRh3cynk9ESdleo~AhdQgy04JBKwJVTWiYCicKjve2PwDKB9ILLCzTE6sHjOcgxkQtvXuhQS3ycpaNVZVOULgjHaHystEpFJZRr5W45piEbF0UJ2gIkpMLKrnt1Rx~Sg3EX2Si89GEVLaIvV01by-UYGf726t9-bHpiGrO4i5uhmlqPWeayFMq~HxkORCwONHBlFlq1Pl9NXrRCwpfSbws5A__&Key-Pair-Id=K3NV4LZ47N8M46)

6.  Click **+Create New**.

7.  Enter a template name and add content in the right pane. Use the formatting options to customize the content.

    ![image.png](https://assets.usepylon.com/e6a58e21-be80-4777-9eaf-f73beeee94d9%2F1758792543001-image.png?Expires=253370764800&Signature=gAQT~OiY8RBZMnTT~J9C~AT3bqkgI94wU5EooM8xW4XP3RLix2uyN852uNw9MmRsi2gdVAPTBLpaZBrvbomcynLWUNLgIT6Wt5yiitxOpfeP6zVzV1LhemexWocrfuBrraLw~jBERfEBDdg0HDzvftaAzsy1AaS-jGqavLDlV1Au6CCO1LztJdpb1DbRBapc7NP2vM3F3C852yQ4Ms8Lylh5WIBn5MJ1sF1eLYhgoCvfGpPC4K2wfp36ZbCew4W1JAGDuhBwEyTYUv4dLW1iV34KdKpvbn90xjyo-r7mirUqi-hQD6aT-2whLP94iKjyyEZQP1b6XQgH8Sma5pJMxg__&Key-Pair-Id=K3NV4LZ47N8M46)

8.  (Optional) Click **Add subject** to add a subject line for the template. The subject appears in all email invites that use this template. You can also include emojis in the subject line, if needed.

# Editing a custom email template

To edit a custom email template:

1.  Open a test.

2.  Click **Invite** in the upper-right corner to open the **Send Test Invites** page.

3.  Click the **Templates** icon.

4.  Go to **My Templates**. This section lists templates you created.

5.  Select the template you want to edit.

    ![image.png](https://assets.usepylon.com/e6a58e21-be80-4777-9eaf-f73beeee94d9%2F1758793582993-image.png?Expires=253370764800&Signature=ISAUV-FmQgJ3NbK9BbX2icBffG2x~eKKrzy5g26hqbrjFNy6WaDLFRJ6fzjI6U4sfRt6D~6lzv6xJs08P6VUUYykELiVKFGS3S5oHfCLbJ4jpLquzYgC7Wg3HAYwBVCbmtd2T9eSuLPhB4gZsT90K~m~0B2POEQ04uCPDWTUXLJtcgvqQB-KxHdaG1BUETqgf~v2UA8AhALCmTBTwlfkDD1BHu3qvEfgfCSfIgGTSeDkLoUrV8Fjn6ouFDPLa~Iu19MkkL-fZmXYNB1O4u9qlCfH8-2i~NMYsu332cwsPaVfu7ZefBjNsMSCmNb76lajz8qchNTTqEB9CVM4pv6ypQ__&Key-Pair-Id=K3NV4LZ47N8M46)

1.  Make the necessary changes.

2.  Click **Save**.

3.  Click the **Templates** icon.

4.  Go to **My Templates**. This section lists templates you created.

5.  Select the template you want to use.

6.  Click **Use this Template**.

    The label **In use** appears next to the template currently applied to the invite.

2.  Click **Invite** in the upper-right corner to open the **Send Test Invites** page.

3.  Click the **Templates** icon.

4.  Go to **Shared Templates**. This section lists templates created by other recruiters in your company.

5.  Select the template you want to use.

# Setting a default email template

You can set one of your templates as the default for all email invites. When you set a default template, the email editor on the **Send Test Invites** page automatically loads it when you click **Invite** for a test

**Note:** You can only set the templates you created as default templates.

To set a default template:

1.  Open a test.

2.  Click **Invite** in the upper-right corner to open the **Send Test Invites** page.

3.  Click the **Templates** icon.

4.  Go to **My Templates**. 

5.  Click the star icon next to the template name. A success message appears.

    ![image.png](https://assets.usepylon.com/e6a58e21-be80-4777-9eaf-f73beeee94d9%2F1758792811366-image.png?Expires=253370764800&Signature=m-O1LerAhyTEed9GauAUQuA1VcLRT2qNNw8NpeMC-jpNFoOH67H2tNF5thehaKwZOLIKYX4XikohTClq2LEK6~WZhp5ujn8pAadBnuq8yCH1YnMys6UAetruDTjKmz0Z2K6BjR3IMn2w7B6Xt1fQRAx3xpCB7TURt5MU0cmJvGrh5EuYOPXOmw4jqechQtq6ybLF4hk9V-py~TjWZscfh236q8RoxdcT7BDU-nUH4ucwiLcnrcDgr0vq4FE~0Gf2VBy7tpyYh1PkTpGU2XVcunylvngcxSM3cHoXRmb9Idq2Dn9-apJC80GUg0a1yNO1nbier4K755ME53GReNMt6Q__&Key-Pair-Id=K3NV4LZ47N8M46)

# Test Labels

_Last updated: Dec 13, 2024, 5:05 AM (Last updated 1 year ago)_
---
## Overview

You can create labels for the tests in HackerRank. The labels are nothing but a set of words and phrases which will help in organizing your tests. With the help of these labels, you can easily filter and find the relevant tests. This article will walk you through the steps in creating the test labels.
---
## Creating Test Labels

**Prerequisites**

- You must have created a test.

**Steps**

1.  Click on the **Tests** tab on the home page and then click the required test.

2.  Click on the **Settings** option from the options present below the test name.

3.  From the left panel, click on the **General** settings and scroll down. You can find the **Labels** section.

    ![Labels.png](https://assets.usepylon.com/e6a58e21-be80-4777-9eaf-f73beeee94d9%2F1734046559244-?Expires=253370764800&Signature=XOnJf3f~0SVwGKzR6rSDvsqAwSLSIlijzHMOUMMKvSfxSDpBGlEdI6nfbYlxwiDDvtM6Jbjfl0aHjnqgWzxYcjYQqiuCxAJWd3sABa359wVrYCme2lo~ELI8rVbwnGWbDvMmh5Udy7X7MGCHvvCz2kbjoTQ~rJgLsIT8Bo~Rbccx~t~2Ce1n4LJGr63tLi6wwaflL-cyyL5PYXfrSWJ9cKEXQ2MCMwqDA54ZVaNBP7nGnfTq8pXbke90YcYxYHK94Tjalq8keOapFoHanAn33JeeiZrmQXlJ0XynYa1e~FXRNvx5P9l2N6~kJTf~8cXS~~qGOzqs2cZHEpNrSIO4jg__&Key-Pair-Id=K3NV4LZ47N8M46)

4.  Type your custom labels in the box under Labels. 

5.  Click on the **Enter** option after typing each label to add them. 

6.  Click on the **Save Changes** button to add those labels to your test.
---
### Types of Labels 

- **Role-specific:** For example, if you are hiring a Java Developer, add Java Developer in the Label field.

<!-- -->

- **Difficulty level:** For example, if the test is an easy one, you can assign a label as easy. Alternatively, use labels medium and hard to assign a test based on the difficulty levels.

<!-- -->

- **Other Labels:** Example: If the test is for hiring a beginner level Java Developer, you can add labels such as "beginner" or "basic".
---
### Usage of Test Labels

You can use test labels to find a required test quickly and efficiently. However, you must have added relevant labels to the tests as illustrated above to use them.

1.  Click on the **Tests** tab on the home page.

2.  Click on the **Labels** option in the left pane.

3.  It will display a list of labels. You can search for your required labels and choose the one you want by ticking the **checkbox** before it. You can select multiple labels at a time.

4.  Once you select the required labels, tests with relevant information get displayed.

    ![Test_Labels_Filtering.png](https://assets.usepylon.com/e6a58e21-be80-4777-9eaf-f73beeee94d9%2F1734046559606-?Expires=253370764800&Signature=PWzFMv-b0YpvjnCGS96KlTZTrafiOkhPQzJ~9C~osSWrZ53yacwbStE8fCJbn4MmNy26I3xlXGcukvl7kGVIoM1B~HGx3E40QL6UxrABfF~nxMFlQOHXsKwm1WHmWtpFbln80Jr0~BCMyVvVJCUVlA1Ix2zvUiMnbkllIEXeDIJEVDMsLyCSZswl-4feCjI7PLORgpK6jyIRThuCwjkm1wHfluPrRzD-fflDJCtOWJ57qlSMAOuauOW6KiMN2mNpto5fR0DvazI9cP1ITv1UOF7toKGj9NOCXVHwUu5Z5W1~A2786s6yD0JiakRhQlEdYTxZ-8loiWxUVb1nEVB7eQ__&Key-Pair-Id=K3NV4LZ47N8M46)

# Revoke Test Access

_Last updated: Jun 26, 2025, 12:59 PM (Last updated 10 months ago)_

HackerRank for Work allows admins to revoke test access from specific users or teams.
---
## Prerequisites

- You must be the test owner or have **Editor** access.

- The test must already be shared with the users or teams using the **Share** option.
---
## Revoking test access

To revoke access to a test for a specific user or team:

1.  Log in to your HackerRank for Work account using your credentials.

2.  Go to the **Tests** tab.

3.  Open the test from which you want to revoke access.

4.  Click **Share.**

    ![image.png](https://assets.usepylon.com/e6a58e21-be80-4777-9eaf-f73beeee94d9%2F7dcc3e1b-9239-43bb-9f09-cb0ac6b6a3ac-1750922216630-image.png-a0c6ccc1-8b3a-4f57-87c0-4143b840df1f?Expires=253370764800&Signature=EUN0JBvppfgHqM5luVsthD8ZgtRrBCFCRh1~g8NUiooU3YyowfEoteIIytzX0dAtDNh-qt4MphDUhLpDOKsj10FtUqlO9bI~t-etPRKnShLq2wzYga4N9XtvesqyRvTTLHiCqvTDhqS8L~ZS2Lw3OkI~r4XLMIgd6sFrvQmLMnf8lAVYCF0ctBHNzZXgClEKTqdxBxu0q6U7do1BWQSMH7PzbeQ8kjz2WqP14wWsH3YtIM-RNg~ROPLRT9x5lJCQI8360Dq~oYrVJpRncIB0I5CrLzWu6pqK4dxZGSyLpEVkgpZP4I5VMbkC6esWKioHNnFjwr2GpLPJ83EFsHAPTQ__&Key-Pair-Id=K3NV4LZ47N8M46)

5.  In the **Share Test** dialog box, locate the user or team.

6.  Select the role drop-down next to their name.

7.  Select **Remove User**.

    ![image.png](https://assets.usepylon.com/e6a58e21-be80-4777-9eaf-f73beeee94d9%2F69d6605a-ee42-4e81-9334-bed9765a0fb5-1750922359485-image.png-f4398651-8b3f-49f3-b032-caff0f95fe66?Expires=253370764800&Signature=cVxrbZ-4piESd6djtx2ZbGMGb1E5htp0FeHs96Id3-IwU0ptC1dsEGyHBoBrHK-FILn3QpZUGHd-p9wrUuy2tLrFB2v-qbe8JpTBM44Lp-XCXZ5QRuFtfT~hsau0Mg0aOwM9b4~YbQXA0zbujLRwmQNQL8E9MpmBbxIQjamtAr8ZsWk5FCFCEI791lqf-6E1-wME0mcsH2YTPkwVhmf613Bwlua7cxEPlWbmuwH-tn3lcTT7R3dJXZ5bmu-uR6FCYJosM~HznOzlm3AbNOYvhhYr11PxzHPwNAgqK8NIvBAunwF-RxtADaQK4nb5t55zMbg0P7y-DJh2l8~K-P3PZQ__&Key-Pair-Id=K3NV4LZ47N8M46)

8.  In the confirmation dialog box, click **Confirm**.

The user or team is immediately removed and will no longer have access to the test.
