# Grant Team Admin Access Prerequisites Granting Team Admin access

_Last updated: Feb 19, 2026, 1:56 PM (Last updated 2 months ago)_

Team Admin access allows a user to manage specific teams within your company.

A Team Admin can:

- Add existing users to the team and assign roles.

- Remove team members from the team.

- Configure team-level settings, such as changing department, region, or team name.

**Note:** Only Company Admins can add new users to the platform. For more information, see [📄 Invite a New User](/articles/9482219268).
---
# Prerequisites

Before you begin, ensure you meet the following requirements:

- You have Company Admin or Team Admin access.

- The user is already a member of the team. For more information, see [📄 Inviting an Existing User to a Team](/articles/2203617737).
---
# Granting Team Admin access

To grant Team Admin access:

1.  Log in to your **HackerRank for Work** account using your credentials.

2.  Select your profile icon in the upper-right corner.

3.  Select **Teams Management** from the drop-down menu.

4.  Choose one of the following methods to grant Team Admin access:

    - From the **Users** tab:

      1.  Go to the **Users** tab.

# Cancel Subscription Cancelling subscription

_Last updated: Mar 10, 2026, 12:16 PM (Last updated 2 months ago)_

You can cancel your subscription if you no longer wish to use HackerRank for Work.
---
# Cancelling subscription

To cancel your subscription:

1.  Log in to **HackerRank for Work** using your credentials.

2.  Go to **Manage Subscription** from the profile dropdown.

3.  Click **Cancel Plan** under the **Current Plan** section. A confirmation window appears.

# Updating billing address

Ensure your billing address is accurate to maintain proper invoicing and tax records.

To update your billing address:

1.  Log in to **HackerRank for Work** using your credentials.

3.  Click **Update Billing** under the **Billing Address** section.

    <img src="https://assets.usepylon.com/e6a58e21-be80-4777-9eaf-f73beeee94d9%2Fca461b19-c08a-4407-96b5-2f92b3476c38-AD_4nXfYrMs-Y9IMfxMBYXImE5kIqbx_UYvdbIuum3EpAzxYhCPliP2Ele7m-8REduOOIv6GdOAvsfDnrJ5NDm6nVzrfu-kPFfN4V0GbECEgSsyHqVzPkbC_k7Mvb3RJ_1ZOEL9KJ04wJQ-95447d13-ea62-46cd-bca2-48868bba6b80?Expires=253370764800&amp;Signature=GpQyfWn3-pxWIo0-bGbCXTi9eNQsovbccc8UWy~-cnV4PUK0Md~8~HSg6SLxLZgvMwEibNaUa4dbc53LQcNWFsNPXKI4vQ7mJTz7KpDrh9mxTA7W-gD4APqz2~xyGvHAMrGIR4JVhhPR2ufXxZ29vpyepckpd1b4W8cYPr4qW5YA7VnEnm0XJvodn5QTIVUBoTlrCLlVPIbtmSeSj6yVPnz7u8yV4oRTpk5SU~kwduBk8PhsRsF-AkncxawCUX~otLo6J1xsuCyAaMdo4HXwAZxZ8rdsiXHcC826oVrzkFLY2Pb-JYvH3mgbCrEL49mK7lwsfiBu6xF9xZoTm8AD6g__&amp;Key-Pair-Id=K3NV4LZ47N8M46" class="kb-image block" data-drag-handle="false" />

    - Street Address

5.  (Optional) Select the checkbox to apply the same address as your shipping address.

# Downloading an invoice

You can download invoices for accounting and recordkeeping purposes.

To download an invoice:

1.  Log in to **HackerRank for Work** using your credentials.

2.  Go to **Manage Subscription** from the profile drop-down.

3.  Scroll to the **Order History** section.

    <img src="https://assets.usepylon.com/e6a58e21-be80-4777-9eaf-f73beeee94d9%2F56951752-0f7b-4e45-98f8-f733230a57f8-AD_4nXecZiQ0twZ1_WQK3YkXhhdpqLzhaVluC0fftVMsPGk4WP0Bn8nCueKOECmjCyd9uQnpg2Bl2yjN3Ew6VA6HegxEb1Kg4MGyKnB9r13LPKwjeshREenhB7Mvzz5rNiFheLjOh9vP-e8e9d64e-8fe8-4fc6-9b07-02b91f8b8f04?Expires=253370764800&amp;Signature=QKEaCm6734BoSIvE5yLnQeuUmK8v0PkzQdLPd5I-loVSN6pNUQx3DEFqtjqrXKmfA~KtWRlSaODRwQ4HROhvJUgwMCS~Li6LOp97KWuHBgJyApJxEbPaf56Y1vJbYGBqPH999cowbfwGE0Nz5ywLIyQxLgIBaDP2-HD7F1ru-~nKs00LEjQINJpz1MTOsqhxLkrGtawzPb3SyjUTTUJatPrjf56G-aPq2T9Ba~geLyeuEMSFn-AQTmRuhj9Qa~06Og3DVx~QcHHKopF-4tw~bltRnc3IRfZBZo9f34DPCObW5loIHfwASXp0vdbByIauqenesrxs7y9gea7FT~gllA__&amp;Key-Pair-Id=K3NV4LZ47N8M46" class="kb-image block" data-drag-handle="false" />

4.  Locate the invoice you want to download.

    <img src="https://assets.usepylon.com/e6a58e21-be80-4777-9eaf-f73beeee94d9%2F0e1696b8-f892-4d40-917b-a144fcd383b2-AD_4nXe3-1eYKz3L1e3EkzFlv5sx5gelqms6_s75C7avLC3KZnFMryPoZAYAJ5G-YTWlytRCc6uWxLfE7NhFqVR9d8Eejv3OTqSttbSzzaFyInD4u7GU4qF-F3cTsDWn4wcF0WVBi6cZ-9ae3e241-5558-40b6-908d-c7c36ca2abf7?Expires=253370764800&amp;Signature=nySm5S37YsXsmJ6SIuYj9QWlxz-cEf~sYlIaPo02BGSpBCZgkYpE6ksIhzft2xjpKTPjdGBLtaeLNhW2NmKpAlSlIfU2pcAOoJWlY3J19kIIIUI6Q2ukSEWu2Sqw8rwPKAPCJvNMgjLCsuZK~OiwG4U~kcwzSJ5XBRzmtI4R7wdDEi-c-KSkSuQGDbqw9G8sMr3ab35Osro3FM8ttWI5WnKqmnM6Kg-Tf3i0ucKYg9Wo4~Eoxg4E0UI7tHCpnb0jLiRoyR5nE3pIzFSHVauSwead1Mk9gn8S1xVXv7vdbVMIe3Wzu0vdKJ06L8U4ZY~1cFQ8hnkM5qQZtoZeLuNJGA__&amp;Key-Pair-Id=K3NV4LZ47N8M46" class="kb-image block" data-drag-handle="false" />

# Pause Subscription

_Last updated: Mar 6, 2026, 12:18 AM (Last updated 2 months ago)_

The **Pause Subscription** feature allows individual self-serve plan subscribers to temporarily pause their HackerRank subscription instead of canceling it. This feature enables you to resume your subscription whenever needed, ensuring flexibility and uninterrupted access when required.
---
### Prerequisites

To use the **Pause Subscription** feature, ensure the following conditions are met:

1.  You must have an active subscription that started at least 30 days ago.

    - This includes accounts in a renewal grace period (7 days) due to a late recurring payment.

2.  You must have a **monthly subscription** for one of the following plans:

    - Individual Monthly - Basic

    - Interview Monthly
---
### How to Pause Your Subscription

Follow these steps to pause your subscription:

- **Access Subscription Settings**

  - Click on the **profile icon** in the top-right corner of the page and select **Settings** from the dropdown menu.

  - Navigate to the **Billing** section under **Subscription**.

![mceclip0.png](https://assets.usepylon.com/e6a58e21-be80-4777-9eaf-f73beeee94d9%2F1735204522902-1734046450926--e2b3523e-4764-4305-a8ec-b633652a6be1?Expires=253370764800&Signature=KV0vI1E72eXd8zmjMmAxMJ2jSHnr47Is5sds28iD3GpUVf0re6AAQME2yZ1Dz~nGQAdrmuVaTFYqEZSyoqEBk-5GBlM3GdKNehZVltkBGPBBCYvGruRumncpeCdUSy7cOSVDULg51X7m-5cOwwuhJqriWLLfHn1kdGIn3mP5LUceYGHtoZ36eOnbRk2Yrf0GmlD2Vr2AC4G1PpuzNzRFY3366W4MOA8WFA8~AJ8ZP-IpQ5A4Tw3RYexwFnzXdvtXFAFppr15PZD0sAXZrIC8OtWis~kwAyQ6iFUBwbsxlASOJ8CSkS7HpbeQu00~zARepviIrIyrKFsAVWEaoH8VKQ__&Key-Pair-Id=K3NV4LZ47N8M46)

- **Initiate Pause Subscription**

  - Click the **Cancel Plan** button. The UI will display a prompt about the new **Pause Subscription** feature.

  ![mceclip1.png](https://assets.usepylon.com/e6a58e21-be80-4777-9eaf-f73beeee94d9%2F1735204594500-1734046451310--866c5ba7-ff6f-4caa-b988-81a10f550230?Expires=253370764800&Signature=as8xLYCyLext-DKmtcvXP3fxuBK6gS-TIQMHekaPZosGYBpLOLdxbRYCzOk9r~SGEhDprqoog92YOrrSQscK2UsbBfLEHJbHjSQJEs31t4AWh63Npp2JSEtpgqI3fF2Si2VYZFVDZtumPBqW6NFz6GJg75fOAlQ1QpoTyLzwX2WV1SMGEbPAyLY3nRH2NcMf7Q8rSQAfP93hJmVc27L~NNXZcTiBsh8GCaucAiriy99HN08jeKsBzgbBbtNh4NVJksXcpt28L-6yy9HPbKghLo7qyB7SXhSEWk8g4JT0qqnlqMjQbD12nB13GZDDKM8nvl4DlxVavuTUhyReRySDaw__&Key-Pair-Id=K3NV4LZ47N8M46)

  - Select the desired pause duration:

    - Minimum: **1 month**

    - Maximum: **12 months**

![mceclip2.png](https://assets.usepylon.com/e6a58e21-be80-4777-9eaf-f73beeee94d9%2F1735204607902-1734046451740--a352e7b2-dee6-4e9d-8d00-d14cff821580?Expires=253370764800&Signature=QWxwujBCaWzp6SnvJtn76OflxBcHuRW24LhnnF29J2lQ-2W0RtMuKqfiApOBmd2wcqmI7Ko5uKNuoV5kwojytPjLfvXPz6~~nt7GXEBknj61WobxMUl3hRnii~c37lC86j3lYIDqWy9y9rSZksEoRHx8g6DepxgK-K-PaMr4tuJ~2UmgU-Yv5NhPbDj8LMOeuSZ-IXuJKS4QZ0ml-ZdvL7bYCIq8HTdmlB0wvR60SohsKpXiilgM5PFW9tD1s70fPEmC4mtWofU3ELYf-z3eF~iuacaz6ajsFiCN4hzg~IWCpQrkb0zjxZTvwPcDYMNctC2Jrp3BKpUV2-Z1Ofq9QQ__&Key-Pair-Id=K3NV4LZ47N8M46)

- **Confirm Pause**

  - Click **Confirm Pause**. A confirmation message will appear, displaying the pause duration and the automatic resume date.
---
### Resuming Your Subscription

If you attempt to log in during the paused period, you cannot access your HackerRank account. A popup notification will inform you of the status of the pause.

![mceclip3.png](https://assets.usepylon.com/e6a58e21-be80-4777-9eaf-f73beeee94d9%2F1735204625356-1734046452141--20fd5b6f-27d9-473f-954d-5bb6cf56ad5f?Expires=253370764800&Signature=cIxTpe0aiLvY5Q5VoR-m-Glf4sSgZTSAcNblpmtXUMS~7yHejs8LvGUIU8xUQOrQnKQZcHnVbCVHECJnxkgDaIG-qKZM03Hbf08tQV1-mE4pJXnlLvRnJTGO9F00FB8K4WvPTMEPFwmDywWB92DUNAT2G~3PXBKA~CoxKSY4j-isQIhwjSrtxu9mywzBp8JztSD5SLS-Lp~JG65dq14tO99qYJQaujeHq1MWguj10VraX4rVFHS7q9cmC~gnxwvU8TSQ1VmWJOklnaouDLsGPuCCxT8S9o1W5bhdysVqOUTrRghhiuqBopH~FcV6dQV~Y9PY6wpnRWjVeTHI8SpbCg__&Key-Pair-Id=K3NV4LZ47N8M46)

To resume your subscription:

- Click **Resume Early** to visit the **Billing** page.

![mceclip6.png](https://assets.usepylon.com/e6a58e21-be80-4777-9eaf-f73beeee94d9%2F1735204643123-1734046452537--50bcabfc-4467-4253-b16e-fbffbbe72d60?Expires=253370764800&Signature=Qz3JVSuSbhyeJpJaOl0EJp1KWmUVKdumwwssP3STSnGyyHm6A7XlHobET-UxtIr-E1nMl0gl0MDxq5bRHr6Fps6e3aMUggpgNQWo5ujRBnZ2E4ZcjWno~fAI-v-Ya06C1nXwB1UpYaPLUBYZQYpaTk936uBJCvUjyTboYtt2xntqb4NvJmQkVp8yfs3VkJPfIKCN2Dexdo-z5yI3OHinQ9I4hOtvgt-Jw75~1GYQK1vPoMRYLqyNT3lnRfOaJDPhul3nMEm584Tn4JCU2D3umGw-gY6U6sMvSF8RosZjrO0ABmEOoyORwLnI0HYYuQ6H20JtE83DBcXm5lSLAmRSLQ__&Key-Pair-Id=K3NV4LZ47N8M46)

- On the billing page, click **Resume Plan**.

![mceclip8.png](https://assets.usepylon.com/e6a58e21-be80-4777-9eaf-f73beeee94d9%2F1735204654279-1734046452967--95a9a1bf-d33d-4a18-bdd4-e8d831ba0126?Expires=253370764800&Signature=nw43KsqtY2772oKqr7UTQoVWwF-AgDoGEh0vYeL--UUSgdYqgqv0ZwYunkK9ml~Nfuk3F4Bup9qH2EK75UKXZzCPGPBaQirqLqkFC82OVRtwZjZLqTJhHmzAG4hMnKgAw-w0WIjl6zekHsYd34QodDcopsxZB6yzsSXUX1maZqLsHmoUrl3aNl0XnjRGwxnwQlgamBpdoJ1w4WX4-Nz-nRN2qaJYlA-9bfkNWVFuZUk9NYkyTK7thl-3bhiLRUpg3DuRRLPYxSijun6TgF0GFv14gFyDa091OlRq8vbLc8tj0gczp642fd6UKfXuXMhJ71x9kgnUxg-bXp8HoDs~Zw__&Key-Pair-Id=K3NV4LZ47N8M46)

- Confirm your selection in the popup by clicking **Confirm**.

![mceclip7.png](https://assets.usepylon.com/e6a58e21-be80-4777-9eaf-f73beeee94d9%2F1735204685018-1734046453519--e068c371-a36e-4648-a381-a722d8f7aab6?Expires=253370764800&Signature=GuZAa662b1jMt44J4bFA-W0AG9Pi86tRzIFSSjfkzHaMo0lGwOBjuqijIZc1HpiWZiH7T~8gKBrtg3Vwjua7EFlWnNBwaOoP4Z53tuVO-iD7p3hwregkxzujMsVBxc7JvWZaSvVoduvj0do--xZ5OE3n7ejOebgmD6iFsHkgsOamC7Fs4ldqRHS6hsbNt1jL8H6CK9UaTjULo3p4qNFMNePFUhfrwshQNopBv-Iu3oMnkvPIjHjvB5oRtlEMEE6qAJQp2DpHRCD2C-w54v4-luqhtotdqCHF5vcg7E5ctzjs046ORTP4d-URkUugI~yiTx~Sl1W1YoeBZD3fsB3q3g__&Key-Pair-Id=K3NV4LZ47N8M46)

- You will receive a notification confirming that your subscription has resumed and your account is active.

![mceclip11.png](https://assets.usepylon.com/e6a58e21-be80-4777-9eaf-f73beeee94d9%2F1735204706297-1734046453872--24d36f01-5207-4fec-bfdc-01308acf9a91?Expires=253370764800&Signature=iHLbBxLV532Q4gCk7toycY2jguMjfkxinTmqV-pIPZ-9RrnYVSnMc9gFYuf4Zv64tSXCh8GsgLE6iRMM3aVdPFEKxM5E4RL6RB0giPGsIyDOxb~gL411ukuVebpWrFO-jwrB1p1TMgiyXZftOBoV24TF3y~F84F2zgTTbfOigmkPJhy0l8riPGJDL~9ztvDlv9jNDkPq6GefpDf-I8Fddfo~n3j7-DeXSa7HwrOkO7YBRK8sW-lNsD5Ub~Gn8e6wOswtRLkp8w5yYpbRoieKCKjwStvRLQDEHekN0lyCFG4HdMQlqy-n8FY4YwJm6n3okDe6yqkKFsG941U7iRv13Q__&Key-Pair-Id=K3NV4LZ47N8M46)

### Extending the Pause Period

You can extend the pause period even during an active pause.

- Navigate to the **Billing** page and click the **Cancel Subscription** button.

![mceclip9.png](https://assets.usepylon.com/e6a58e21-be80-4777-9eaf-f73beeee94d9%2F1735204725125-1734046454221--78707721-ef4c-45e3-be69-14924f22dcff?Expires=253370764800&Signature=DwtbVSiiM2fUn8xOkCeMwlfDkvlrnNPRh2ulZJTNb2DmSPneKCc3wx2gIKN~J3152jKUmcTj1fS4Y203j-VbkxS-dmqIWb0zuOB4c3NyvlXWYtLbrMuTAfUTmo6T77uZei1byiexI7R998D9E3DspFwsQqOtGZNBoYUU~egDGwjBi7wa7E6GA~eKajoX7jpb4Mx6C~cB1Z6M-c41KEG4bZQkRdtnjftpqUZsQ2LSa0EKv~wu~gEd7S7xp8XQXtU6OWrdB~K0KObanx8cJ4GC4gN3DYnp1gTMaeB2rwkCS1T9ZbUXHfdwFCzu623pzyuoBELTz2hPKILQquxkrjWEwQ__&Key-Pair-Id=K3NV4LZ47N8M46)

- In the popup, select **Extend Pause**.

- Choose the new pause duration and click **Confirm Extension**.

![mceclip10.png](https://assets.usepylon.com/e6a58e21-be80-4777-9eaf-f73beeee94d9%2F1735204751076-1734046454676--63224f3e-f423-4069-b261-83636b81ecfe?Expires=253370764800&Signature=omWzoI2HyuwUQaeL2gB7q7LGjeeqIXbdv3M8A5Lr7MZZct6mAwF5dWS2-8hILASe2L4p36OCmr2stPM38Fkqt5G6pBJtWu9yF4RNQ38BBxP6E4P7GOWxqIMcHXOCkMagXRCM5nG1gDB1NRiq3KkUpYugZkDx2C6Tq~ApTGF3JWLTv4kyzSd6sqswaby6hFE~OtyKBbP590JUJJ0M-5LYj5XiHqL56BgaCAkPIqx4YkiAhe~Ta5u3npUlEYeg-D0Rn4sjy-7Ltx5anioxLW5dI~B1xLwiB8kjc3p~UEBMHa3HLKXpAP3bm32jN1nnotRwRWf~NStz6-CJL~1DOVF5yQ__&Key-Pair-Id=K3NV4LZ47N8M46)

# Report Settings

_Last updated: Dec 26, 2024, 3:19 PM (Last updated 1 year ago)_

You can set up or change your preferences for the Microsoft Excel CSV reports generated for the candidates. These reports can be downloaded from the Test Reports page. The preferences you set here are reflected in the Microsoft Excel CSV reports you downloaded from the HackerRank platform.
---
## Accessing Report Settings

- On the top right corner of your HackerRank account home page, you can access Settings. 

- You can find the Report Settings placed on the left pane under User settings on the settings page. 

  <img src="https://assets.usepylon.com/e6a58e21-be80-4777-9eaf-f73beeee94d9%2F1734046748653-?Expires=253370764800&amp;Signature=scxZS3nP9MKibWNoYQ3js6hZbPo2n2ORzvbqZpknITcyWCBmlvgKYdpxPlUDtN33pajsp48jerazcVbofG-U-0uWiaoUR4gqcI31IQ48Fvmku8P~nGE5zW~6m-NdED-d4dxPXh0s23~puyaIHs8c7-08Ru5BN5czyZIoTuItRsIeTSvsqe0c8eD6RAxRLZ2-ERU0YHviIOFuwHv9DKE5wFboTPa4XT-CXMbYufZmakNRo6Z2JjFmE3zFsh2hYsX6xyXP7VvTXgqP3bx5s~kVehaaxFT3pseaQtM59cIM2kSLN5nRIhPVtZc4c9nqcAzWzPzXT1VbCqI1-1e0SQ7VNA__&amp;Key-Pair-Id=K3NV4LZ47N8M46" class="kb-image block" data-drag-handle="false" />
---
## Components of Report Settings

Report settings are divided into six sections, each with fields you can select or unselect by ticking the check box attached to it.
---
### Candidate

In this section, you can select the candidate fields you want to include in your report sheets, such as their Email, ID, Name, Tag, and IP Address.
---
### Company

This section allows you to include your Company ID and Company Name in your reports.
---
### Test 

There are several fields in the Test section. The definitions of each field are given in the table below to help you better understand when choosing an option.  

|  |  |
|----|----|
| **Term ** | **Definition** |
| Invite ID | Invitation ID is generated while inviting a Candidate.  |
| Invite Method | Method of Invitation  |
| Invite Valid From | The date and time from which the Invitation allowed the candidate to take part in a test. |
| Invite Valid To | The date and time when the Invitation gets invalid.  |
| Invited At | Time of the Invitation |
| Invited By Email | Email of the recruiter who invited the Candidate.  |
| Invited By Name | Name of the recruiter who invited the Candidate.  |
| Role | the test is created for.   |
| Test Duration | The duration set for the Test.  |
| Test ID | The ID of the particular Test.  |
| Test Name | Name given to the Test |
| Test Owner Email | Email of the Test creator.  |
| Test Owner Name | Creator of the Test. |
| Test Tags | Tags given for the Test.  |
---
### Attempt Settings 

The definition of each field related to a candidate’s attempt has been given in the table below.

|  |  |
|----|----|
| **Term** | **Definition** |
| Attempt Count | The number of attempts made by the candidate.   |
| Attempt Endtime | Ending time of the candidate’s attempt.   |
| Attempt ID | The ID of the candidate’s attempt |
| Attempt Plagiarism | Plagiarism in Attempt |
| Attempt Start time | Start time of the Candidate’s attempt. |
| Attempt Time Taken | Time taken to finish a test.  |
| Cutoff Score | The cutoff score of the test taken by the candidate.  |
| Detailed Report Url | Url to access the detailed report of the candidate’s attempt.  |
| Feedback Comments | Feedback comments given by the candidate at the end of the test.  |
| Last Attempt Date And Time | Candidate’s last attempt date and time.  |
| Max Score | The maximum score attained by the candidate  |
| Network Disconnected Duration | Duration of the time when candidate lost their network |
| Number Of Window Exits | The number of times the candidate moved away from the test window. |
| Out Of Window Duration | Duration the candidate spent away from the test window.  |
| Percentage Score | Percentage of the score attained by the candidate.  |
| Proctor Flag | Flags raised by the HackerRank proctoring system. |
| Proctor Flag Reasons | Reasons behind a candidate getting the proctoring flags.   |
| Product Rating | Rating given by the candidate at the end of the test.  |
| Score | The final score attained by the candidate.  |
| Status | Status of the candidate’s attempt |
---
### Team

|            |                                  |
|------------|----------------------------------|
| **Term **  | **Definition**                   |
| Department | Department of the hiring team.   |
| Region     | Region of the hiring team.       |
| Team       | Hiring team.                     |
| Owner      | Owner of the hiring team.        |
---
### Attempt Result

|  |  |
|----|----|
| **Term** | **Definition** |
| Candidate Detail Answer | Detailed Answers given by the candidate in their attempt.  |
| Code Language | Code language the candidate used to answer the question.  |
| Compile And Test | Compilation and Test of the code written by the candidate.  |
| Copy Paste Frequency | The number of times the candidate copy-pasted something in the code editor. |
| Lines Of Code | The number of code lines written by the candidate.  |
| Mcq Answer | Multiple choice question answer |
| Plagiarism Link | Link to the webpage from where the candidate plagiarised the answer |
| Plagiarism Percent | Percentage of the plagiarised answer in the candidate’s attempt. |
| Question Answered | Status of the question in a test, whether answered or not.  |
| Question Plagiarism | If a question is plagiarized in the test. |
| Question Score | The score attained for a question in the test.  |
| Question Type Score | The score attained by the candidate for each question type.  |
| Section Score | The score attained by the candidate for a particular section in a test. |
| Skill Score | The score attained by the candidate for a particular skill in the test.  |
| Subjective Answer | The answer of the subjective questions.  |
| Tag Score | The score attained by the candidate for a tag attached to the test.  |
| Test Case Is Passed | The candidate’s answer passes the test case attached to a question. |
| Test Case Memory | Versions of the test case results were saved in the attempt. |
| Test Case Time | Time is taken by the candidate to pass a test case. |
| Time Taken Per Question | Time taken by the candidate to answer each question. |

# Safelist/Allowlist URLs and IP Addresses for HackerRank Affected areas Allowlist URLs Allowlist IP addresses

_Last updated: Nov 19, 2025, 7:52 PM (Last updated 5 months ago)_

When you create questions or answer tests, you may encounter errors caused by blocked domains. The HackerRank platform notifies you of blocked domains in the IDE and identifies the ones you must safelist to ensure seamless interaction across various features.
---
# Affected areas

The IDE displays the notification for the blocked domains in the following areas:
---
## Screen

When you access blocked domains through the screen functionality in the IDE, you receive a notification that specifies the domain you need to safelist.

<img src="https://assets.usepylon.com/e6a58e21-be80-4777-9eaf-f73beeee94d9%2F1734046399487-?Expires=253370764800&amp;Signature=a1p7pfrGU0rET~~M4b23tZ5NvqmH35OGMvftv6NCVY8u0nkPkn7~duez1dqkuADawFUVgAjBZrawsMSHVGos8lZLz~mxZ1kDiTwEmx3DFzSMfK~0T48PXzY~9qLX6XgFpnZKrP2dZ9RFTleVgmtSyIwkbQj-7nWwnmVtZ8BfXGYHXJIsqcXm8CIFoSThcBGoPIwAROXx2hB1B0UVqWTZ4X0Sp4D1oLLTWNtzGtC4pRPiYRi74nFg1lvltK2cPK81z5cToBOhpJnVHvjTsydwXkBZWSIBoua686psgKrG6mULMjZXJO1aiezzSJ-66QtQIfi1xLK0cWAwX3jY7wZD2A__&amp;Key-Pair-Id=K3NV4LZ47N8M46" class="kb-image block" data-drag-handle="false" />
---
## Question creation

When you create questions and attempt to include content from a blocked domain, a notification appears to alert you to the domain that requires safelisting.

<img src="https://assets.usepylon.com/e6a58e21-be80-4777-9eaf-f73beeee94d9%2F1734046399944-?Expires=253370764800&amp;Signature=h56qNp~jg0IEs9RtpWTP17p-FARz~h4u4omCleD5b9kXGb6LNLn5m70Gsp10DxjCbq2dl7S9bj5CQc2UDW6MqkGkQvEjSQj6Ju4X0jJGmbVP8LHDLrC9OFhsQHXfOCQRFnGpyFnI48CORlTeNkGAHaPP08I9BUn~lbM45U9xhn-M2BPjEG8dzrfVjAODs~45IQXRAyCHMmiXPBxKN-4Je8u7Mu7-E3AG0dS3NqbCrj2au-Q7EXDYOfea8mOF0NYD43PchgDUKRJOPZBZIvH6xD3cMSeZRpKklNfXkO5cOFrqCxwA1JmiI6B94EiBBU1bVgREV~g5Yms4sIBJdjmjtA__&amp;Key-Pair-Id=K3NV4LZ47N8M46" class="kb-image block" data-drag-handle="false" />
---
## Reports

When you generate or access reports in the IDE, any blocked domains referenced in the report content trigger a notification.\
The notification displays the blocked domains, making it easy to determine which ones you must safelist for uninterrupted access and functionality in the IDE.

<img src="https://assets.usepylon.com/e6a58e21-be80-4777-9eaf-f73beeee94d9%2F1734046400318-?Expires=253370764800&amp;Signature=Am0XVhexeooZnxGno6~RCLUMx1F5edaF5XPQE3m-s7zzif-bipni1C13aHeO47ycPZFelNB1fJym5VT2hkzg~r0xjb6y3aC5Tk6lVj08WgJYIxUnq6vvcarD7l-xsXvBLwUnecH4snsgwAgVKwr4XCvQNzYJGUumXPoVFOMgt9SzT4T8IUMurM6l2NiUxXeYodoLnrGBBMdyocEwpJgRu80zQi8DB3IqUlk9wXxoNzwMaA8k0qu0b8-rr8--mzMSoXunEOof1FRDfIB0L5GQ4vRepqcqTUdcs1~V0C3xvUElg~u-bnYDsOOx~qBGnECbxITOZg4r~sOSv7L3RuZIsg__&amp;Key-Pair-Id=K3NV4LZ47N8M46" class="kb-image block" data-drag-handle="false" />

# Time Zone Settings

_Last updated: Dec 13, 2024, 5:06 AM (Last updated 1 year ago)_
---
## Overview

You can change your time zone settings to reflect the time zone in which you are located. By default, HackerRank selects the time zone based on your location while creating the account. This article will walk you through the steps in modifying the Time Zone settings.
---
## Modifying the Time Zone Settings

1.  Click on the arrow next to the user icon on the top right corner of the home page.

2.  Click on the **Settings** option from the drop-down menu that appears.

    ![Settings](https://assets.usepylon.com/e6a58e21-be80-4777-9eaf-f73beeee94d9%2F1734046605066-?Expires=253370764800&Signature=nIIQCBZFm2B9RLCtYAePWshMp2QBamv269Yj32n6P-kd~i36VCojGQLkTUX9YzQw72OiIQiWkAaWkROZPsrlhVi~eeV~eR6mGHOMq8XeIn-hPH1EQKW4GInOz9DoHGt8MYs8p9SwEhyaThP3Yy6ATbvsPKh0KfldPfvmvJohIfcqTRWlZHBaPFpVIrXJ9V9GTkA1KEFbm8MSPX6zQUCnvZbR67rIzu6R3FACFF4eEsP-lhbYEEUE1gADDIGXMu3HLQ6ZiEj1Ptkp3EDrvb9LTgBlT4o3gq-LS6RQGIHCZ6dOsCe-WSBd93fTOLAWgfSKeBI17kDPI2DcdO-e0jv4Xw__&Key-Pair-Id=K3NV4LZ47N8M46)

*Accessing HackerRank account settings*

1.  Under the **User** settings click on the **Profile** option, scroll down to **Your Time Zone** section and select the required time zone.

    ![Time](https://assets.usepylon.com/e6a58e21-be80-4777-9eaf-f73beeee94d9%2F1734046605492-?Expires=253370764800&Signature=YYhfqFZlCqM8iwPrTFOPq~91~XseruLwon5mbsU3F6FtK93sOjevVGAzFtraz50Rx3rYSaKfWaQ-UqygPV2afCxfWN-tGpV679pMZZylmRVqF6WEEEPpCHWf33SAjs4ryqYg6TwNJ0hfmna6bMdjycuu08IMyu3U6pPbuKCDUNoxtPROlaowba~V11qw7MK72waddr7L7ubZNbjnm13NBeIYcawAFzUuWQNVKe4Hz5U9F6NuHLELlfdagzF6d0gPx88frUOYyWIBqSOcv7RltVJaNY7UF3E7iMtNkEMF206t-XL8jEX5lxVZOl2NQfkDDDpT~Kb-zDN3-l3kmFo1qg__&Key-Pair-Id=K3NV4LZ47N8M46)

*Setting a time-zone*

1.  Click on the **Save** button to save the time zone you have selected.

# Update or Reset Password Updating password Resetting password

_Last updated: Feb 23, 2026, 12:33 PM (Last updated 2 months ago)_

You can change your password at any time to keep your account secure. Use a combination of letters, numbers, and special characters for added security.
---
# Updating password

To update a password:

1.  Log in to **HackerRank for Work** using your credentials.

2.  Select your profile icon in the upper-right corner.

3.  Select **Settings** from the drop-down menu.

4.  In the **Change Password** section, enter your current password, new password, and retype your new password to confirm.

    <img src="https://assets.usepylon.com/e6a58e21-be80-4777-9eaf-f73beeee94d9%2F55ee842c-fdde-4918-9abb-4a053d087171-AD_4nXfyJOIHOnvkVSgXXBqhsdFnT6LN3wryYnXK4Y2cZ7qNSAZfLinXoGN_Et-bEuDectdxaaFs3E7qioSfucv3h5uWsJmQiKxOCmWRFIfpQPcz3iVUuNVNPtThSmMLCFTmfRdRI6yVlw-ce56bd32-37ed-4f71-a6b5-9d370c3cb5ae?Expires=253370764800&amp;Signature=h4SBkIredvcCW22jR~Rw9nvm3fiXT-dAfwhMHKpA57C~pILUoCQZWDwL4YIkWYI9itXvJJTmB9D5KwzXhUdQQiQZKkPB5g7jZWcdjcB4kngxvBtfxRuz8twCVEqV~oM3vSuhmFwva-Q~jkoLXTJem5IkAqqKDjG7xYNKot7qKriUtlOFtq~Biz7vUPTxYWzNGKVPwLB2kVoz79UtimZZMUYYe0p2Y9OoOsL12ZVT~KIqtLS1TNncGRePtaeiTsLGoFhTwNuVHiFI3UGC-is8~f-Dqv1YgYy9z~pnlW8~DP7dTjKYM8KmXjXm8suLzQPHktAUfngqmXdzSaQJ2sPdZw__&amp;Key-Pair-Id=K3NV4LZ47N8M46" class="kb-image block" data-drag-handle="false" />

5.  Click **Save**.

**Note:** If you forget your current password, use the **Forgot Password** option on the login page to reset it.
---
# Resetting password

To reset a forgotten password:

1.  Go to the [HackerRank for Work](https://www.hackerrank.com/work/login) login page.

2.  Click **Forgot Password?** under the password field.

    <img src="https://assets.usepylon.com/e6a58e21-be80-4777-9eaf-f73beeee94d9%2Fba2098a0-25fd-4540-be8b-22162546efef-AD_4nXcfZaFqveIjoF0r78h6u7fu_b1gf2jWGjsUpZbCwCr6rdvYuke6rpzZhzI1LPo2LBGmjEw1KnssNTIdqkhvoOyjKrE2mZbRfm9y4GLDdSQ7BfFhOhD7Kjxu_4Is6fGgzGRrcN6IjQ-4d4309e9-1afe-454b-930a-df09793c8234?Expires=253370764800&amp;Signature=VRYahrGPT-g55WR8P1-HyUiYYDu8LyK41AvivJmBlr5BFp42SD2GdoRKa9xuHhu9pcTNQpllkxRTc1UzoyhdPQvqvJdlHmoUcujcuBnXiAge7MIJoO4zGodABI2Zb465qgA~D5VGWF6Ip~ZZVCBUoy1mj-wi-msR-QHWKS9WwvRpYBS69jJ090cXzHgASKlFcNMHHz6ZZUDZrbm-ynL6GJKi1Dx1OWbuibXa~dWJyxXUrc7yxCJ4qwJJpYFqJ6zaPYrQfkDFhFimXJ5sVUd1yxm~Xoizs-sd~6-Ee5H78k3ccFE0x40dQbBb2Qg8~48HLiMfg2n~Nb7AQ5Cn53QIjA__&amp;Key-Pair-Id=K3NV4LZ47N8M46" class="kb-image block" data-drag-handle="false" />

3.  Enter the work email address associated with your account.

4.  Click **Next**.

5.  Check your email for a password reset link from HackerRank.

6.  Follow the instructions in the email to create a new password.

# Email Notifications

_Last updated: Dec 26, 2024, 3:12 PM (Last updated 1 year ago)_

You can adjust email notification preferences for your HackerRank account by following these steps:

#### Accessing Email Notification Settings

1.  Click the **arrow** next to the user icon in the top-right corner of the home page.

2.  From the drop-down menu, select **Settings**, and then choose **Email Notifications** in the left navigation pane.

![image.png](https://assets.usepylon.com/e6a58e21-be80-4777-9eaf-f73beeee94d9%2F1735206141671-image.png?Expires=253370764800&Signature=KGEgLgkfJ9XHUN-sX8QjM6oqmlbEh0qd6gMpIXk3oCgM4dAzAKvLS1nKeh3-sEn2g0CqhTh1U-~jUcwS64WR-U6QOQkMbGO63oK9VO6KuiD8hXBQHb3XsmF-ZZVL51yNjpELQejITg2dC7xhhfDiC~04XDsEtPwBY3sHTLnZR8T1yzziKtVyoUaC3tKQjAn24W-XtTASK2KVeJ6irc9xdgiN1ywuHyYOxFW-tv1A6I7EN0MZuj1Izzk92KAa5ySocrLkQb638HZMsNwxhmIYvljjnOqyM1c068IP97dd5zjA6ae2HcY3tX1yJFvlE63vGwIQ~-jsA3f2N8lowDKY8w__&Key-Pair-Id=K3NV4LZ47N8M46)

#### Configuring Test Notifications

- **Default Setting**: You will receive an email notification after a candidate completes a test.

- **Custom Options**:

  - Disable notifications for test completions.

  - Enable notifications only if a candidate's score exceeds the cutoff score.

  **Tip**: Specify the cutoff score in a test's **Advanced Setting**. For details, refer to the [Modifying Score Settings for Tests](#) article.

#### Configuring Interview Notifications

- Enable or disable the option to send an email when an interview ends automatically.\
  **Default**: Disabled.

- Enable or disable the option to send an email if you provide feedback indicating a poor interview experience.\
  **Default**: Enabled. This email helps collect additional details to improve your experience.

#### Configuring Product Update Notifications

- Enable or disable the option to receive product update emails.\
  **Default**: Enabled.

#### Finalizing Your Changes

- Click **Save** to apply your preferences.

\

# HackerRank's Approach to Accessibility

_Last updated: Jan 3, 2025, 4:46 PM (Last updated 1 year ago)_

At HackerRank, accessibility is an integral part of our software development process. We are committed to creating inclusive experiences that empower everyone to access and use our platform effortlessly. From the earliest design decisions to final testing, we ensure our products meet accessibility standards and provide a seamless user experience. We create products that work for everyone by identifying and addressing barriers early.
---
### **Proactive Testing and Audits**

- **Regular Audits**: We conduct internal and external audits, ensuring alignment with accessibility standards.

- **Tools and Technology**: We leverage tools like **Axe** for automated testing & **NVDA** and **Voiceover** for manual testing.
---
## **Prioritizing and Addressing Issues**

Accessibility is an ongoing process. Issues are prioritized based on their impact, ensuring critical challenges are resolved first.

- **Critical**: Block access to core functionality. This is resolved with the highest urgency.

- **Serious**: Significantly hinder access but allow alternative paths. These are prioritized right after critical issues.

- **Moderate and Low**: These cause minor inconveniences or fail technical criteria without affecting usability. We address these as part of our long-term roadmap.

This approach ensures we address the most pressing needs while steadily improving our platform.
---
## **Third-Party Components**

While we strive to address accessibility challenges proactively, we rely on certain third-party components for specific functionalities. Fixes for third-party components are often beyond our direct control, and hence, third-party components are excluded from our accessibility scope unless an accessible alternative is available.
---
## **Accommodation options**

Limitations posed by third-party components or intricate technical constraints may prevent immediate resolution. In such cases, we provide in-product [accommodation options](https://support.hackerrank.com/hc/en-us/articles/360032485533-Adding-Extra-Time-for-Candidates#:~:text=The%20Time%20Accommodation%20button%20is,reflected%20in%20the%20invite%20template) and dedicated support to ensure users can effectively achieve their objectives.
---
## **Commitment to Continuous Improvement**

We continuously evaluate and refine our processes to align with evolving accessibility standards and user needs.

- Through each audit and review cycle, we identify areas for improvement, address potential gaps, and enhance usability.

- By investing in tools, training, and internal processes, we prioritize accessibility in our continuously evolving products.

\
For inquiries or to access our latest Accessibility Conformance Reports, please contact us at [accessibility@hackerrank.com](mailto:accessibility@hackerrank.com).

\
\

# Advanced Account Settings

_Last updated: Dec 26, 2024, 12:54 PM (Last updated 1 year ago)_

Customize all default settings for your test setup by following these steps.

**Prerequisites**

- Recruiter license access

**Steps**

Accessing **Advanced Settings**:

1\. Click on the user icon in the top-right corner.

2\. Select **Settings** from the dropdown menu.

3\. Click on **Advanced Settings** in the left navigation pane.

<img src="https://assets.usepylon.com/e6a58e21-be80-4777-9eaf-f73beeee94d9%2F1734046554800-?Expires=253370764800&amp;Signature=pwNCa5yH9g-QtPqHao8WGZJ7KfV0kg5QDQd~bbpSo0DMB7~3v2yfmAzN8biOAEbLJidI7mxWXOfnI4qEPwDRe1vLNyBAHAkxOCWa382SzSFQiHMJZwov1U5r4JvjrLyAIlZ3hXiBwgXODXK5lma3hEKpzvlshWv4oADKzxbE0FZUHuRAdeVd9qtbJFCzw~zu-6gGfkrLuCHbnDoeR~134nREpsULLiEmvoT9B8RTHX3WrjpLpa-MaE-mDL6dfB2lFlgAJ9uy2Yk7Wceos97j09u4gz615TWuvhXoAc8TLaqtWNLvhBQT8CWU5T~6-9by6LpvZCh1uC8JYJqD62aGIQ__&amp;Key-Pair-Id=K3NV4LZ47N8M46" class="kb-image block" data-drag-handle="false" />

#### **Adjusting the Advanced Setting Options:**

1\. **Default Candidate Tags (Tests):** Specify candidate tags to identify candidates you invited. You can add more than one tag.

2\. **Default Template for Test Invites**: Add a default template for test invites. This template will be used for all invites you sent.

3\. **Default Invite Expiration Time:** Set the default invite expiration time for all your tests (applies to invites sent via the website or API key).

5\. **Default Test Reminder Time: ** Check the box to set a default reminder time for all candidates across all your tests. Only one reminder email will be sent per candidate.

6\. **Default Test Reminder Time**: Checking this box will unlock three options

- **Invite with an expiration date:** If you have selected a valid expiry date for your test, you must specify this field.

- **Invite without an expiration:** You must specify this field if your test has no expiry date.

- **Reminder Email Contents:** Customize the text you would like the candidate to see

**Note**: If you configure the email settings on the **Advanced Settings** page and the **Invite Candidates** page differently for a particular test, the settings configured on the **Invite Candidates** page will take precedence.

# HackerRank SkillUp Licenses

_Last updated: Dec 13, 2024, 5:06 AM (Last updated 1 year ago)_
---
## SkillUp 

SkillUp is a comprehensive platform designed to help organizations manage and develop their technical talent effectively. It offers a range of features and tools to support developers and employers in their growth, workforce planning, and talent mobility efforts.
---
## Licenses For SkillUp

HackerRank SkillUp offers the following user license types:

- Platform License

- Org License 

- Individual License

Each license type provides access to specified features and functionality within SkillUp. All licenses must be assigned to individual named users within your organization.
---
## Platform License

The Platform License provides access to all the SkillUp features and functionality included with both an Org License and an Individual License. Access to functionality is granted through SkillUp Org and SkillUp Individual licenses.
---
## Org License 

The Org License provides users with access to the following features:

- View company overview

- View company talent directory

- Export Individual User details from the talent directory

- Assign goals to Individual Users

- View the Skill Profile of all individual users

- Add users 

- Export the list of individual users in user management

- View and store certification assessments for use in connection with SkillUp

- View raw reports on certification assessments

Org Licenses are intended for use by Admin, Managers, and Executives. Admin users are granted access to a corresponding Recruiter license in the HackerRank platform to facilitate their use of SkillUp.
---
## Individual License

The Individual License provides users with access to the following features:

- Explore the role directory and skills directory

- Execute learning plans

- Take skill badging assessments and role certification assessments

- Download Role Certificates

- Manage their Skill Profile

Individual Licenses are generally intended for use by individual developers within your organization who will access the skills development features of SkillUp.
---

# Audit Logs in SkillUp How to request audit logs

_Last updated: Jan 28, 2026, 10:13 AM (Last updated 3 months ago)_

Audit Logs provide a detailed record of organizational activity in SkillUp. Organizations can use audit logs to support governance, security monitoring, and compliance requirements.

Audit logs capture key events performed within SkillUp, including:

- User additions, removals, and role changes

- Badge, certification, and assignment-related actions

- Administrative configuration changes

The information included in an audit log varies based on the request and the selected time period.
---
# How to request audit logs

To request audit logs, contact the SkillUp Support team at [skillup-support@hackerrank.com](mailto:skillup-support@hackerrank.com).

**Note:** Only administrators can request audit logs for a SkillUp account. This restriction ensures that only authorized users can access organization-wide data.
---
## Sample template

You can use the following template to request audit logs:

***Subject:*** *Request for SkillUp audit logs*

\

*Hello SkillUp Support Team,*

*I am requesting Audit Logs for our organization’s SkillUp account to support internal audit and compliance requirements.*

*Request details:*

- *Organization name: \[Your organization name\]*

- *Requested time period: \[start date – end date\]*

- *Relevant event types (if applicable): \[Categories of events to include. For example, user authentication, administrative actions, or assignments\]*

*Thank you for your assistance.*

*Kind regards,\
\[Your full name\]\
\[Your role/title\]\
\[Your organization\]\
\[Work email address\]*

**Note:** If you have questions about audit logs or are unsure what information to provide, contact [skillup-support@hackerrank.com](mailto:skillup-support@hackerrank.com).

\

\

# Get Started with Certify

_Last updated: Apr 23, 2025, 11:51 AM (Last updated 1 year ago)_

The Certify experience in SkillUp enables developers to confidently work toward and earn certifications in key roles. It provides a clear, guided path through practical, untimed challenges that build the skills needed for success.
---
## Intended audience

The Certify experience is designed for: 

- Individual developers who want to demonstrate their capabilities through hands-on certifications.

- Organizations that aim to validate internal skill development and promote talent readiness.
---
## Using Certify

To begin using the Certify experience:

1.  Log in to **SkillUp** using your credentials.

2.  Go to the **Certify** tab.

    ![image.png](https://assets.usepylon.com/e6a58e21-be80-4777-9eaf-f73beeee94d9%2F1745153743788-image.png?Expires=253370764800&Signature=Qe8dQsYz5YIRV8OvIzO0DM82sEs7KPWN8lDEoX7SLI0TPrVAwqUkGjlpZetH1-sx60bwO3-Yri4GS-eUzw4S8e5UIn14SGmk82H4JJmfSGVc~VAEmkHwFfB5Y64flNw1RhZtOYHEEiJXvFbd3bMAAKXrOTN5a6cIv0SSZpDFBwxFO-RiJej39CJpZNMXwV0ZDqEaqJygoNam2JamwR7KWpDb1scoDGfxBPJ5K6kMfF8dLHWyVPMVSBQU~j5zP9gl0s-XRqRT8M48k8e7-F-qO8yhAJf5CA8jRqnJhliQK1SApLBV~hSxx0S1S3gljEET23KEtbUNRUxYIm2esZjSsw__&Key-Pair-Id=K3NV4LZ47N8M46)

3.  Select a role certification track (for example, *Frontend Developer - React*).

4.  Review the list of required practice challenges.

5.  Solve each practice challenge at your own pace. The AI tutor is available for support during practice.

6.  Complete all required practice challenges to unlock the certification assessment.

7.  Attempt the certification when you are ready.

**Note:** Certification is a timed assessment conducted on the HackerRank platform.
---
## Common use cases

- A developer preparing to transition into a specialized frontend role, such as Angular development, wants to demonstrate their capabilities.

- An employee aiming for internal mobility uses certifications to validate readiness for a new role.

- A manager encourages team members to earn certifications that align with organizational skill goals.
---
## Best practices

To get the most out of the Certify experience:

- Take your time with practice challenges. Use the AI tutor to fully understand the problems.

- Practice in short, consistent sessions instead of completing everything at once.

- Use the sample environment to get familiar with the certification test format.

- Track your progress to ensure all required practice challenges are completed before attempting certification.
---
## Known limitations

The following limitations apply to the current experience:

- The AI tutor is not available during the certification assessment.

- Certifications are time-bound and can only be reattempted after a cooldown period.
---
## FAQs

**Can I attempt the certification directly?**

No. You must complete the required practice challenges before unlocking the certification.

**What happens if I fail the certification?**

You can reattempt the certification after the cooldown period ends.

**Is the AI tutor available during the certification test?**

No. The AI tutor is only available during practice challenges.

**Can I download or share my certificate?**

Yes. After passing the certification, you can download and share your certificate from your SkillUp profile.

\

# ‭Reporting APIs Available endpoints Configuring reporting APIs‬ Error handling Best practices Rate limits

_Last updated: Oct 14, 2025, 9:05 PM (Last updated 6 months ago)_

SkillUp’s Reporting APIs allow you to programmatically extract skill signals, badges, and certification data from your organization. These APIs enable you to integrate learning insights with HR systems, build customized reports, and connect learning outcomes to business impact.

**Note:** Only administrators can generate credentials to access these APIs.
---
# Available endpoints

|  |  |
|----|----|
| **Endpoint** | **Description** |
| Credentials API | Returns a list of all available badges and certifications in SkillUp. |
| Users API | Returns user data, including learning progress, badges, and certifications achieved. |
---
# Configuring reporting APIs‬

SkillUp APIs use the **OAuth 2.0 Client Credentials** flow for secure access. Only authorized systems can request and retrieve reporting information.

To configure reporting APIs:
---
## ‭Step 1: Generate OAuth Credentials‬

![ReportingAPIs (2).gif](https://assets.usepylon.com/e6a58e21-be80-4777-9eaf-f73beeee94d9%2F1760426646769-ReportingAPIs%25282%2529.gif?Expires=253370764800&Signature=avWPKb67QURKfzp-9Nd3HGyLRI9LsjwsKxojUbqSWczAMTa6SQ9xa1MZff3QdRXUd--A3fKLJCqmBCB1Y3a1fsaUM0WTjSgMC9NbONDRfBsmSLKxfg6WVOZtsL-5lnvt-N7IWaHSQ~uncnPmFRdswrMbJ8ou21TU58J4x-T~~zhNWKazWx8xv21NjYkEXfLVAUfppmSW3-IKsnk2IG3TMymLMVH-10-AuO2icwH0JuzXKzbhSqamF5KgEJSRqtpdhEVyGXOwgQUfR4Nx6FqOc8-KRnt1E1pQDPpvVTyUngYmh81nIbkWnXol-SdVucX3RtcYcAUwlTz-pB~1TZl7Hw__&Key-Pair-Id=K3NV4LZ47N8M46)

1.  ‭Log in to **SkillUp** using an administrator account.

2.  Click your profile icon in the upper-right corner and select **Settings**.

3.  Click **Register New Application**.

4.  Enter a name for your application.

5.  Click **Register Application**.

6.  Copy the **Client ID** and **Client Secret** to the clipboard or click **Download JSON** to save the credentials as a file.

    **Important Note:** The client secret is displayed only once during generation. You must store it securely before closing the dialog because you cannot retrieve it again.

Your application is now successfully registered, and you can start making API requests.
---
## ‭Step 2: Request Access Token‬

‭As a security measure, you must first obtain an access token by making a POST request to the` /v1/oauth2/token` endpoint.

The Authorization header must include your client credentials encoded in Base64 format.

1.  Combine your client ID and client secret using a colon (:).\
    Example: `client_id:client_secret`

2.  Encode the string using Base64.

3.  Add the prefix `Basic`to the encoded string to create the Authorization header.\
    Example: `Basic <base64_encoded_string>`.

**Note:** The access token (JWT) is valid for **10 minutes**. When it expires, repeat these steps to request a new token.
---
### Example

<span class="mr-auto truncate">Plain Text</span>

```
If client_id = "abc123" and client_secret = "def456"
Combined: “abc123:def456”

Base64 encoded:”YWJjMTIzOmRlZjQ1Ng==”

Final header:”Basic YWJjMTIzOmRlZjQ1Ng==”
```

**Request**

<span class="mr-auto truncate">Shell</span>

```
curl -X POST https://www.hackerrank.com/skillup/api/v1/oauth2/token \
-H "Authorization: Basic <base64_encoded_credentials>" \
-H "Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded" \
-d "grant_type=client_credentials"
```

**Headers**

|               |              |                                      |
|---------------|--------------|--------------------------------------|
| **Header**    | **Required** | **Value**                            |
| Authorization | Yes          | Basic `<base64_encoded_credentials>` |
| Content-Type  | Yes          | application/x-www-form-urlencoded    |

**Body parameters**

|               |              |                    |
|---------------|--------------|--------------------|
| **Parameter** | **Required** | **Value**          |
| grant_type    | Yes          | client_credentials |

**Response**

<span class="mr-auto truncate">JSON</span>

```
{
  "access_token": "eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9...",
  "expires_in": 600
}
```

|              |          |                                                |
|--------------|----------|------------------------------------------------|
| **Field**    | **Type** | **Description**                                |
| access_token | string   | The access token for API authentication        |
| expires_in   | integer  | Token validity period in seconds (600 seconds) |
---
## ‭Step 3: Access SkillUp APIs‬

‭After you obtain a valid access token, use it to call the SkillUp Reporting APIs.

Include the token in the Authorization header of your request.
---
### Example Request

<span class="mr-auto truncate">Shell</span>

```
curl -X GET https://www.hackerrank.com/skillup/api/v2/credentials \
-H "Authorization: Bearer <access_token>"
```
---
# Error handling

|                 |                   |                                        |
|-----------------|-------------------|----------------------------------------|
| **Status Code** | **Error**         | **Description**                        |
| 400             | Bad Request       | Missing or invalid parameters          |
| 401             | Unauthorized      | Access token is invalid or expired     |
| 403             | Forbidden         | Token lacks required permissions       |
| 429             | Too Many Requests | Too many requests made in a short time |
---
# Best practices

- Store credentials securely. Never expose client credentials in client-side code.

- Tokens remain valid for 10 minutes. Cache and reuse access tokens instead of generating new ones for every request

- Request a new token before the current one expires.
---
# Rate limits

|                  |                      |
|------------------|----------------------|
| **Request Type** | **Limit**            |
| Token requests   | 1 request per second |
| API requests     | 1 request per second |

For more information, contact [skillup-support@hackerrank.com](mailto:skillup-support@hackerrank.com).‭

# Custom Certifications

_Last updated: Jul 30, 2025, 9:55 AM (Last updated 9 months ago)_

Custom Certifications let you convert any test created in HackerRank for Work into a SkillUp certification experience. These certifications mirror the experience of standard SkillUp assessments, but your team fully owns the content. 

Standard Certifications may not align with your tech stack or internal standards. With Custom Certifications, you can build assessments that reflect your team’s real-world challenges and complement existing SkillUp content.

![Custom Certification.gif](https://assets.usepylon.com/e6a58e21-be80-4777-9eaf-f73beeee94d9%2F1753767345737-CustomCertification.gif?Expires=253370764800&Signature=f-t3HYPu~hGVh1T6YVzwNFPggZSPhPu4U6X4udbtbXwTItE-RybfozAY9jyNgx2Lfoz0a9rUC-HWduAyTdaLooLC0UFVZJT~8wZxEf3jXdCNQOsZ4XGs7ZatqqFwEsoumW~9aoFmlu-k5l7mcnuDqKiSQ-bxqcsiucUbBjgF5sQrhDyuu6f0u23qB66pBvLe~BLoZ9WqUBY7YcCZYAYAJzr~XPxYZe0~Z3s3J8JFmfe3u6phre0FNLCOH9YDBbSuTdS2vjwzsjavr6eDLhFsiLrT4H08y2nwC~IdQw0wzrldqBy3vuS0Ije2TuU8LM7dwtwlEi530HTD0K~UXpxVaQ__&Key-Pair-Id=K3NV4LZ47N8M46)

Companies increasingly build skills-based mobility programs and invest in internal talent development. Whether you prepare junior developers for advancement or reskill engineers in new domains such as cloud, AI, or full-stack development, Certifications help you measure progress with clarity and rigor.
---
## Intended audience

The Custom Certification is designed for: 

- Engineering leaders or learning and development (L&D) teams who design structured learning and certification paths

- Platform owners or HackerRank for Work administrators who manage test content and track outcomes

- Developers and employees who participate in internal upskilling or mobility programs

- Enterprise customers who build custom skill frameworks and signals alongside SkillUp’s standard certifications
---
## Best practices

To get the most out of Custom Certification:

- Use hands-on, real-world problems to measure skills objectively

- Pair the certification with a recommended SkillUp Learn track so developers can practice in advance.
---
## Known limitations

- You need support from HackerRank to activate a test for a SkillUp certification. After you prepare the test in HackerRank for Work, contact your account manager or [support@hackerrank.com](mailto:support@hackerrank.com).

- Library content restrictions apply. You can only use questions available in your HackerRank library, or you can create custom questions.\
  \

# Adding a new user

To add a new user:

1.  Click **Add New Users**.

    ![image.png](https://assets.usepylon.com/e6a58e21-be80-4777-9eaf-f73beeee94d9%2F1760452180280-image.png?Expires=253370764800&Signature=HbMJ7X3rATY4ssHToXjUV4iM9g9S0dHC~UNA2qRUqtokfcYlv-JLALH3tv6cWtHh84hbPBLY3d4HJ8iBRENcsn9YlITXRqawcILXIvpRKv-g~QpjEkwKrNQhWTAeMReLiFdyzm~jcUAB0NdOyPznBslU8k8uOIdkHUV3x3pz6rzgM0ts1LZnRaPmJV-gj1Es5qsWVs08gbuo9ndUdizMmGriHh~3syYJxgYjPz-FoLC~K36CwklPe8OWg8dMV37UB1VyqzQAAkvjcrDkoNDyttEc7h7g1G4fTOLU0iu6pONuBlbLEaCURVDdS3kzk3i52-ttl4fVDOrhuFIIHKjXiw__&Key-Pair-Id=K3NV4LZ47N8M46)

2.  Choose an option:

    - **Invite user**: 

      1.  Select a role:

          - Individual License:

            - **Individua**l: Explore skills and roles, earn badges and certifications, and create a skill profile. 

          - Organization License:

            - **Manager**: Access all individual features, assign tasks to team members, view insights, and export reports.

            - **Admin**: Access company-wide insights, reports, and user management tools.

      2.  Click **Next**.

      3.  Update the following fields:

          - First Name

          - Last Name(Optional)

          - Email

          - Job Title

          - Manager

      4.  Click **Next**.

      5.  Select certification:

          - **Allow users to select:** Let users choose their first certification.

          - **Assign a specific certification**: Choose a certification from the drop-down menu.

      6.  Click **Add User**.

    - **Upload CSV**: Upload a CSV file to add users in bulk.

# Accessing SkillUp Employer Platform

_Last updated: Apr 3, 2025, 12:33 PM (Last updated 1 year ago)_

The SkillUp platform for employers consolidates skill-level data in a single portal.

To access:

1.  Log in to your HackerRank account.

2.  Navigate to the top menu and click on **Hire**.

3.  Select **SkillUp** from the dropdown menu.

The platform consists of two main pages: **Overview** and **Talent**.
---
## Overview Page

This section provides a graphical representation of your organization’s certified roles and skills.
---
### Key Components

- **Company Overview**: Displays metrics for certified developers, assessed developers, and onboarded managers. It also tracks certifications and skill badges earned within your organization.

- **Role Certification Funnel**: Click on a role to see a detailed breakdown of employee certifications with the ability to download the data.

- **Certification Trends**: View certification trends over time, filtered by specific roles or periods.

- **Engagement and Assessment Trends**: View engagement and Assessment trends over time, filtered by certifications and badges.

- **Track Developer Actions:** On the Developers Onboqarded dashboard, you can track the details such as:

  - Number of developers invited

  - Number of developers signed up

  - Number of developers attempted to get a badge or certification

  - Number of developers who completed a badge or certification

![Overview Page SkillUp.gif](https://assets.usepylon.com/e6a58e21-be80-4777-9eaf-f73beeee94d9%2F1742288486731-OverviewPageSkillUp.gif?Expires=253370764800&Signature=CZofqdvPDD7UCB2rI38mBkw4VsXzKOg8IlNPiMhFEJBhiJVwzFASOrOcsrtBvn~XJ-3Rrg11dslYTtFHqgFili9vvFvfClw15-ZSO4cl2UtJcHjz0k43zKHc-jKJkE5v~fH6BnyCSGVvd9TLPczArJHxhD5A5XZq74ybvVY7JgZMGJxj~tzilv2EjaJjGghptztvqLtXUWYi4VJBrt42JWayUlx80HIwQzOTEB2uccWSF6Xgpw7mMzbs0Jv3izwiOqVb2b37Rl0Xjfr4PpMswO0y47sXm65ayst~LhlK7VJ5doZ3v1x3TVkv60jSmNixAayngtEQt3OIXxlNMkMEuA__&Key-Pair-Id=K3NV4LZ47N8M46)
---
## Talent Directory

The Talent directory helps organize your developers based on **Designation**, **Certifications**, and **Skills Proficiency**.
---
### Features

The dashboard consists of two tabs:

- **Direct Reports**: Displays data of team members who directly report to you. 

- **All Reports**: Displays data of all employees within your department beyond your direct reports.

# HackerRank SkillUp

_Last updated: Dec 13, 2024, 4:58 AM (Last updated 1 year ago)_
---
### Introduction to SkillUp

SkillUp is a solution to support internal upskilling and mobility within your organization. It allows individuals to assess their skill proficiency and receive personalized learning plans for developing skills relevant to their current or future roles. 

Skill development is validated through badges and role certifications, ensuring employees and organizations can track growth. For employers, SkillUp offers a comprehensive view of the skill inventory within the organization, aiding in workforce planning by identifying strengths and skill gaps.
---
### SkillUp Use Cases

SkillUp creates value for employers and employees by providing visibility into your workforce's current and future state, enabling data-driven development.
---
### For Employers

- **Workforce Planning**: Gain insight into your organization’s skills distribution. Use this data to understand workforce strengths and gaps, supporting effective upskilling initiatives.

- **Talent Certification**: Accurately certify current skill levels, eliminating assumptions and guesswork. Use this data to make informed decisions about workforce development.

- **Learning and Development Tracking**: Monitor the progress and effectiveness of learning programs using comprehensive reporting tools to ensure continuous improvement.

- **Internal Mobility**: Identify potential Employees for internal job roles by reviewing verified skill profiles and progress in development. This feature can support career advancement and reduce employee turnover.
---
### For Developers

#### **Upskilling Resources**

- **Vast Learning Library:** Access a comprehensive library of learning materials, including courses, tutorials, and hands-on projects. These resources are tailored to enhance your skills across various roles and technologies, helping you upskill and benchmark your proficiency.

- **Verified Skill Profiles:** Create and maintain a verified skill profile on **SkillUp**. This profile highlights your proficiencies, achievements, and technical expertise, giving a comprehensive overview of your skills.

- **Curated Learning Paths: SkillUp provides customized learning paths b**ased on your current skill level, career goals, and organizational needs. These pathways ensure efficient, targeted skill development aligned with your growth and organizational objectives.

By leveraging **SkillUp**, developers can take charge of their skill development, earn credentials, and explore internal mobility opportunities. Employers can make informed decisions about technical talent, drive upskilling initiatives, and ensure a skilled, productive workforce aligned with business objectives.

## Frequently Asked Questions **How is a proficiency level determined?** Skill Ratings determine the proficiency level. HackerRank determines the cut-offs for each proficiency in a skill-based on inputs from SMEs and how the top 10% of the employees have scored in a particular assessment that determines the skill proficiency. In the case of custom assessments (tailored to meet the organization's requirements), the organizations set the cut-offs. **What if I take multiple assessments that assess the same skill?** The Skill Rating would be based on the results from the most recent assessment taken. This will help us keep the Skill Rating accurate and up-to-date to enable your decision-making process. **How can I access past Skill Ratings?** In the profile of an employee, you can go to the Skill Details section to see the progress of Skill Ratings over a period of time. **How many retakes are allowed for an assessment?** The employer will determine the number of retakes for each assessment based on their policies. The cool-down period is determined as the days to pass before taking the next retake. **What is the difference between Skill Ratings and Badges?** Skill Rating is a quantitative indicator of an individual's proficiency in technical skills. Badges, on the other hand, are a way of acknowledging an achievement or a skill acquisition at a skill proficiency level. You can receive a badge when you have taken an assessment and reached proficiency level. For example, If you take a Java assessment and achieve the required Skill Rating for expert proficiency, you will receive the Java (Expert) ^ badge. **What happens to my skill rating if the assessment is retired or updated?** If an assessment is deleted from HRW, it is considered retired. You will continue to see the assessment scores in the Assessment History, but your Skill Rating will reflect the most recent Rating before the retired assessment. If the content of an assessment changes, it is considered updated. However, your skill rating will not be affected if an assessment is updated. **How can I add custom learning resources to SkillUp?** You must provide an Excel sheet with the links to custom learning resources like Pluralsight videos or Udacity courses. Within two business days, the HackerRank team will manually add these links to the relevant skills. In the future, you can add custom resources through the admin dashboard. **Can I influence the content in certification assessments?
---
is considered updated. However, your skill rating will not be affected if an assessment is updated. **How can I add custom learning resources to SkillUp?** You must provide an Excel sheet with the links to custom learning resources like Pluralsight videos or Udacity courses. Within two business days, the HackerRank team will manually add these links to the relevant skills. In the future, you can add custom resources through the admin dashboard. **Can I influence the content in certification assessments? ** No, you cannot influence or customize the content in the certification assessments. Hackerrank is taking a strategic bet on AI-first learning and will invest in providing guided, immersive AI tutors for each skill and role. The certification content will be Hackerrank's proprietary AI-powered assessments. **What is the difference between a badge and a certification? ** A badge is earned for demonstrating proficiency in a skill after passing a skill assessment. Certification is earned for a role that combines multiple skills after passing a comprehensive role assessment that includes prerequisites of earning the relevant skill badges. **Can I transfer skill badges earned outside the company (e.g., on the HackerRank community) to my employer's SkillUp account?** You cannot transfer external skill badges into your organization's SkillUp account. SkillUp treats personal community certifications separately from professional employer certifications to maintain data privacy and boundaries. **How often are the global in-demand skills updated on the SkillUp platform?** The global in-demand skills showcased on SkillUp are updated annually based on HackerRank's skills report research. However, the company is exploring increasing the frequency of these updates.

# Track Developer Progress Using Overview Dashboard

_Last updated: Apr 23, 2025, 11:47 AM (Last updated 1 year ago)_

The **Overview** tab provides SkillUp administrators with a clear, actionable view of developer progress throughout the upskilling journey. With insights into onboarding, engagement, and certification trends, the dashboard helps administrators track skill development at scale.
---
## Intended audience

This feature is intended for the following users with **SkillUp administrator** access:

- Learning and development (L&D) professionals

- HR and talent leaders

- Team managers responsible for internal upskilling initiatives
---
## Tracking developer progress 

To track developer progress:

1.  Log in to **SkillUp** using your administrator credentials.

2.  Go to the **Overview** tab in the left navigation panel.

3.  Review the top-level funnel metrics for each stage:

    <img src="https://assets.usepylon.com/e6a58e21-be80-4777-9eaf-f73beeee94d9%2Fa7f7824f-cfdd-4f80-8edd-b6cc511d543d-AD_4nXeZQydcsFW-QhyEbz9-6UIXE-6OW1HYa6RJTeE4eCdMF_aVpBR8bRrHR1FXZLGG3YGwGWrQ7kh4uNbNZDIrw4FjzDTEPJwhJpeFY3nvUlyV20k60Ac1e3wfyGsY-zP9WGrFtQG-Tg-3e7db600-2d08-4a60-a6ed-9b0e7e8dc1c4?Expires=253370764800&amp;Signature=P~9KYKUlN0oTMJvOaizNCio4jT38qY1QUfqiRjQqmZ8f1HhMBVZrAUOjkTxOWo1NpPDeWjF2XcW4mHcgl9rGRL9comtXyCFt1pkHVCwGfC5GKR6NuK93bkDrXK9jFb2aLh7z2aN6ObIIqEvxMZBAY24xnQdBzOiDQxvEBE7ermN9grjNTqwn0v05EoqQzmEq~H27ksHc7Ai0mqR5-fMNTFGeHC1o22axAOJisQGb8CFysPG1-bhnu0gVvGi5N0WtCjrZdyiPkr~1PJhAUQZN~dhRXrKDcMvd6nASvXwrFWTavVCPSBq9oywY1bgU2ka1tPX6c0WPE1UDbdFpwUGbiw__&amp;Key-Pair-Id=K3NV4LZ47N8M46" class="kb-image block" data-drag-handle="false" />

    - Invited Developers

    - Activated Developers

    - Engaged Developers

    - Certified Developers

4.  Use the date filter in the top-right corner to view progress by time periods (For example, Last week, Last month, or Last quarter).

    <img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXdggY9bi_xZ5bE7nXXSOHWWCfZHjQfmz_Xq5Zufjb-RTAdgmIN8wXQfrJugQ11OTIbmOdJVgPi9ctiic_YbeWLshQQik37F09Y0lZR3fNDaCsRBEboOxgKbLDiJcjZPD5B6B6ZKRA?key=X_ZeYuiSgC31MswfGpDFpaY-" class="kb-image block" data-drag-handle="false" />

5.  Explore certification and skill-specific breakdowns to understand where developers are making progress in their upskilling journey.

6.  Scroll down to view:

    - Manager-level tracking

    - Onboarding trends

    - Certification trends

7.  Click the export button to download dashboard data for reporting or deeper analysis.
---
## Common use cases 

- A SkillUp administrator tracks weekly or monthly engagement across teams and identifies roles with the highest certification rates.

- A people leader uses the funnel view to monitor how many invited developers have become engaged.

- An L&D professional downloads engagement and certification data to measure internal mobility aligned with upskilling goals.
---
## Best practices

To get the most of the **Overview** tab:

- Use the time filters to monitor activity trends across different time periods and align them with internal initiatives or campaigns.

- Monitor funnel drop-offs to identify friction points where additional support or communication may improve engagement.
---
## Known limitations

- Funnel card drill-downs are only available when the **All Time** filter is applied.
---
## FAQs

**What counts as an Engaged developer?**

An engaged developer is someone who has run code at least once and made progress on a challenge.

**Can I track progress by manager or team?**

Yes. The dashboard includes manager-specific views that show associated developers and their certification activity.

# Get Started with Learn

_Last updated: Apr 23, 2025, 11:40 AM (Last updated 1 year ago)_

The Learn experience in SkillUp offers a structured, flexible, and hands-on learning environment. It helps developers improve their technical skills through guided practice and AI-powered support.

 It includes the following features:

- Self-paced, contextual learning with guided examples and interactive challenges.

- Real-time AI tutor to support coding practice and concept reinforcement.

- Skill badges that validate proficiency and progress.
---
## Intended audience

The Learn experience is designed for: 

- Individual developers seeking to upskill in specific technologies.

- Organizations aiming to promote talent growth by helping employees gain and demonstrate new skills.
---
## Using Learn

To begin using the Learn experience:

1.  Log in to **SkillUp** using your credentials.

2.  Go to the **Learn** tab.

    <img src="https://assets.usepylon.com/e6a58e21-be80-4777-9eaf-f73beeee94d9%2F3847494b-0b37-4620-a6d4-bc6ef1512241-AD_4nXelCwI8-7r4liSmjbch7ymCg5XVpjJVOMzIhCwLMy-YVHuYwzAWx5rKfNIm6TPaXJHVjYys-xjqibhXEDCa76D66dg1c2drC5DBcPjZBAM0ZW4GtC7BrkQzDHjy4COip95e2wCTYg-fb9cf4e8-e5ac-424b-8847-0665d6f7bbcd?Expires=253370764800&amp;Signature=onAZLmCbZd1zy1tKRcCQGwTSkZLRe7bITdio1k586ls7BunZzl7JY4DN67uh5cUtl1YpDMN-89j5aVGLxBJeTvWlBIh4hp4f950~EoMttfAgpUoohILLe~S-DXOz1wmoyfcoaKXUFPGBh6IJZecTmcZ4mXeXxOsIg~toUgA6wBrHRt6dOCUvnsveGoBzPYosO7I-FGxYHNqXvu8M9BNkVogLqifGJsyO0-6s~lHlyGiIuS00tzI9bWFgAsmla2SGYpmhBj~YUlQrQGJNoymzHiGFIDhWd2phrNPbASZvX4kxBaP7L9nk1FkpWLS3wS0Hvv7fakLGD7F1NoJEg98Jeg__&amp;Key-Pair-Id=K3NV4LZ47N8M46" class="kb-image block" data-drag-handle="false" />

3.  Select a skill (for example, Python, Angular).

4.  Select a concept from the **Foundational**, **Intermediate**, or **Expert** track.

5.  Read the lesson material with examples, explanations, and guidance from the AI tutor.

6.  Use the built-in AI tutor to ask questions or get help as needed.

7.  Start the associated coding challenge when you are ready. The AI tutor remains available for support.

8.  Submit your completed solution.

9.  Complete all challenges in a track to earn a Skill badge.
---
## Common use cases

- A developer preparing for a new backend role wants to refresh their Python fundamentals.

- A backend engineer transitioning to a full stack position uses the React learning path to build frontend skills.

- A manager encourages the employee to upskill and earn a badge to demonstrate readiness for an internal opportunity.
---
## Best practices

To get the most out of the Learn experience:

- Use the AI tutor to deepen your understanding instead of skipping directly to the challenge.

- Set aside short, regular time blocks to complete modules at your own pace.
---
## Known limitations

The following limitations apply to the current experience:

- The AI tutor is available only during Learn and Badge experiences. It is not accessible during timed certification assessments.

- Badges are skill-specific and currently available only for certain learning paths.
---
## FAQs

**Do I need to complete a badge before taking a certification?**

No. Completing a badge is helpful but not a prerequisite for certification

**Are challenges timed?**

No. Learn and badge-related challenges are untimed. Only certification assessments are timed.

**Can I retake a module if I make a mistake?**

Yes. You can reattempt modules as needed and take the time required to master the content.

**Where can I find my badge after I earn it?**

Badges will appear in your **SkillUp profile** upon completion of the Learn track.

# Weekly Challenges Accessing weekly challenges Leaderboard Evaluating weekly challenges Available weekly challenges

_Last updated: Jan 28, 2026, 10:08 AM (Last updated 3 months ago)_

Weekly Challenges are short, repeatable activities that enable users to apply skills in a focused and time-efficient manner. They complement SkillUp learning paths and certifications by offering ongoing practice rather than long-form coursework.

Weekly Challenges support the following objectives:

- Provide structured opportunities for continued learning after completing badges or certifications

- Encourage consistent participation through a predictable weekly cadence

- Introduce a controlled competitive element within an organization

**Note:** A new challenge releases every week. Challenges and leaderboards reset every Tuesday at 6:00 PM UTC.
---
# Accessing weekly challenges

To access the weekly challenge: 

1.  Log in to your **SkillUp** account using your credentials. 

2.  Locate the weekly challenge banner on the right side of the homepage.

    ![image.png](https://assets.usepylon.com/e6a58e21-be80-4777-9eaf-f73beeee94d9%2F1769525879021-image.png?Expires=253370764800&Signature=M~KMbSgH2TiZ-hTuiDsQfWmsc1K9L0Bsq6ms~jpXRS-yEy6KQ~ul1YQ97rWWTPdO~-1K9QLKsJGkkGHLXsksWrXT5SC-NILF7cE7oO2tiWIRX1E1qBlUyY6nz4JjUkGsa~O75fS4w~zfTxeAyv48c6gVNl70BlB4tSjRoUApQsM23OjjtntOwWESxJeV-YGBCsyRTz4DYBEN2qRPr4cL3QlgVFRjr0tCkX06g5HygXOHGIT9feXPYvnPia1skvST7CkO33BxeOzNYycPHfutzmOsSN4N-34lFRzwsyhCd~PMIgxpEWm7eT6GAiG~81ve4B6o2YuTMAF4SIVOsHy27g__&Key-Pair-Id=K3NV4LZ47N8M46)

The banner displays the remaining time to attempt the challenge, along with the current and previous week leaderboards.
---
# Leaderboard

Each weekly challenge includes a leaderboard that ranks participants within the same organization.

Leaderboards allow users to:

- Compare their submissions with peers

- Learn from top-performing solutions

- Track progress across multiple challenges

**Note:** Users can view the previous week’s challenge and winning submissions to learn from them.

![image.png](https://assets.usepylon.com/e6a58e21-be80-4777-9eaf-f73beeee94d9%2F1769525915891-image.png?Expires=253370764800&Signature=hlizgIT~Ii8nn~m1ggeHH3JWmMKUx~QjU5bixfdjLEalebfITUEPbr9qehoOePpd1DSi4kxo95BBM1tPb1ZsIQlrRPiqr87JDElfFa4l6JkxaJz2~xEOHRpI4gfnR~jIC-rnzjnEL9XlqtbT-4C-lUugorym0uzVbRCOlNKOO4I2ywVUOcnBLR1S2mAa9FXp4gQfw-pNf5MoJqE-iLiY4oG7QJ9l-aQnGf8rtA1ezZ2tvQd7UE9EorMJdgJ5hlqtmoENyJO8cSmXWZumFBnQeePRMpvkbSwtp7bHjn51b8gs-~3eHKLMoFswArWVdOugpK~qRkqhbHuBMiDrW7CqyQ__&Key-Pair-Id=K3NV4LZ47N8M46)
---
# Evaluating weekly challenges

Weekly Challenges use token efficiency to evaluate submissions.

*Total score = Input tokens (prompt) + Output tokens (generated code)*

- Lower scores rank higher

- If scores tie, earlier submissions rank higher

- Each user can submit once per weekly challenge
---
# Available weekly challenges

HackerRank currently offers the Weekly Prompt Engineering Challenge.
---
## Weekly Prompt Engineering challenge

The Weekly Prompt Engineering Challenge helps users improve their ability to write effective prompts for large language models (LLMs).

Prompting is a critical skill in modern development workflows. Developers interact with LLMs, agents, and AI-assisted development tools through prompts. Inefficient prompting increases cost by consuming unnecessary tokens or requiring repeated attempts.

This challenge reinforces the importance of clear, precise prompts for generating efficient and accurate results.
---
### Attempting weekly Prompt Engineering challenge

To attempt the weekly Prompt Engineering challenge: 

1.  Click **Start Challenge** in the weekly Prompt Engineering challenge banner.

2.  Read the instructions, then click **Done**.

4.  Write a single prompt in the **Prompt** field that instructs the LLM to generate the solution.

# SkillUp Employee Platform

_Last updated: Mar 6, 2025, 11:50 AM (Last updated 1 year ago)_

The employee platform is segregated into three tabs:

## Home

On the home page, you can see two sections:
---
### My Career

This section shows you the certificates you have earned and tracks your progress toward your next certification goal. To view each role's certificate and progress details, utilize the slider component to scroll through them. Monitoring this section empowers you to take ownership of your learning path.

## Skills Directory

This directory enables you to explore in-demand skills to acquire. You can view globally trending abilities and all the skills available in HackerRank's library, organized by categories such as AI & ML, Software Engineering, Cloud Engineering, Data Engineering, and more. Tracking skills here provide visibility into those that align with organizational needs and can grow your impact.

<img src="https://assets.usepylon.com/e6a58e21-be80-4777-9eaf-f73beeee94d9%2F1734720862847-34903825250707-aeff24c2-f6af-4cca-96cf-6057fd865500?Expires=253370764800&amp;Signature=s-4YT7ulMkOPJT27TtZEuECVxsbZjsAzQ7A8tGVyWsruO89LGFL9SiIUa3jGpbdiJT~xPCmlE0rGdqpZkcmq3pD~GsiLLZBZKo8TtdK8GueGPyCpqWD7aTST22Q3UcMoIFkZ~VHiNS-v1e8XDre9k6fM1QFdNL9mI~vGtE55~ZUMjXwnj6QOY9PxylYbTN5y4qdVjl5SOsahAqjLOB5XBgnucI40TXHTrBFgXINwDmFjoQVm-Ks1Yehb~pguthcEtJReN5tfT9XRMbH-r53M5oWqb5VgcWrDsNPIteq7aOSevDRwC6WzFkhE-GUxfiOItFh7IcUHuFU7xL13uOztpQ__&amp;Key-Pair-Id=K3NV4LZ47N8M46" class="kb-image block" data-drag-handle="false" />

SkillUp categorizes each skill into one of three primary proficiency levels to provide clear insights into your expertise and mastery.

Here is an overview of each level:

1.  **Foundational:** The Foundational level represents a basic understanding of the skill.  

2.  **Intermediate:** The Intermediate level reflects a deeper understanding and practical application of the skill. 

3.  **Expert:** The Expert level signifies mastery and advanced proficiency in the skill. 

In addition to the three primary levels, a **Beginner** designation is assigned when a developer attempts a proficiency-level test but does not meet the passing criteria.

**This level:**

- Indicates an opportunity for growth and learning in the skill.

- Encourages further practice and study to achieve the Foundational level.

- Acts as a starting point for tracking improvement over time.

The recommended learning resources cover the concepts needed to attain the proficiency badge.
---
### Practice Assessment

- To test your skills, you can use the Practice Assessments. These untimed tests provide a safe environment to hone your coding skills without consequences. Only you can access the results of these assessments. 

- These assessments are unlimited; you can keep practicing until you can take one.

  <img src="https://assets.usepylon.com/e6a58e21-be80-4777-9eaf-f73beeee94d9%2F1734720871349-34903825252371-305d9077-f222-46fe-8cac-71f054422063?Expires=253370764800&amp;Signature=fLbvYTZQMgQW9j8fglJfEYUq~cdEuepj-nYU6zgaONK5UKOeb9WqvDaR5bhSUQm04QKhXcxm~JgBjPJPCutvhfsWojrUrgR82HSJ1zjr81a8QRC~EdAEl2wTutH1iynZp8u400oJlEQibawUG3~X8H-1VD28Y0T-PxwVx8YmU5OAU4LW7Tacixjcluv4yKHRCU8p2-tFQB2i2YAVDvHLkOrj9OlH4o-UHuzAaB1xvkfoypSeVKGneQYQc1a-YYm8vxHWw2K4V4TydX-pNh~6UWIQOSws~EzX-oMondwYV-dp6yQV2q3YkhjX2wUqLUm9nspjNvopNUr0TdnASN-paA__&amp;Key-Pair-Id=K3NV4LZ47N8M46" class="kb-image block" data-drag-handle="false" />

  \

- In your practice assessments, you'll have access to an AI Tutor Bot in the form of a Socratic tutor. This assistant is designed to help you learn and understand new skills as you work through real-world coding challenges. The AI assistant can:

  - Explain the problem statement and requirements

  - Debug your code and point out errors or inefficiencies

  - Suggest alternative solutions or approaches

  - Answer questions and guide the way 

<img src="https://assets.usepylon.com/e6a58e21-be80-4777-9eaf-f73beeee94d9%2F1734720927793-34903806088211-63ff658c-b9a5-414c-a2b8-ad0c8786f72e?Expires=253370764800&amp;Signature=cYdrI9X3bX5kOY4av26GoOA5cYtzZaxB8y5XmOM73gBn3YmGUSRlhI5lr4nIQ8tIUMtVt2cdR1L1VfGfmSFJX~oBHrI~e9uO4RBH~f8gHLr5XukqQTHPRfhcAHl3wjUrK2Mvj64uAYGikI~3aX57w6y3AZpKJDV1vemBpU~qRxu4d8zXzWExs5Yt9EAuqsx6mjZU06Pl5Nsc139wCVKiDsJU7JZ0WogD9SgIN-zV6bvjGIlAuGxCx~zMsf7PyPAw1YChWDb7YGO5UmQ2ZzA-77dB-MArAPdODVA8DVBQsW-MrfA0pLsllZhAgvtojPIpBqelM69PMTCYI3IOUJynnQ__&amp;Key-Pair-Id=K3NV4LZ47N8M46" class="kb-image block" data-drag-handle="false" />

Role certification assessments lead to professional credentials certified by SkillUp, validating your knowledge and competency in a particular role. When all the prerequisites are unlocked, you can take the assessment by clicking the Take the Certification button.

## My Profile

Your profile is the equivalent of a resume. You can write your bio here and provide social links, such as LinkedIn, Github, Stack Overflow, Twitter, or a personal website. The certifications you have completed and skill badges you have attained will appear here.  

To access your profile, click on the name in the top right corner and select My Profile.

# Create Custom Certifications Prerequisite Creating custom certifications

_Last updated: Apr 22, 2026, 10:22 AM (Last updated 4 days ago)_

Custom Certifications let you convert a HackerRank for Work test into a SkillUp certification experience. This allows you to create certifications that align with your organization’s learning and skill validation requirements.
---
# Prerequisite

You have created a test in your HackerRank for Work account.
---
# Creating custom certifications

To create custom certifications:

1.  Log in to your **SkillUp** account using your credentials.

2.  Go to **Certify \> Manage Custom Certifications**.

    ![image.png](https://assets.usepylon.com/e6a58e21-be80-4777-9eaf-f73beeee94d9%2F1776693111699-image.png?Expires=253370764800&Signature=BgJ0aVe6i~NRO7EhU9pOXLAUy4xX5LaEWVwM-hYBro4tHoQ2VM2kYAzNsOXtmFfa3Ux2WGbVTZegvdL-l~bs7KE4Wl7Rjc6cL-qYeZ64xdALXcXT097i0plj5u7upze-~VRjGLl6rHClR-0f3DbvbgMeRIw8jrd-Z3pAusPoOAtwe940hiKbLpjnzZSKSqzfV4~bHSTZ5BNn8tSGXhAJps5ElGEQFTcZvjdbQFpX3I~dXzb-TS2mveAXPM4x55NnKI-hjVUZGuyt4pJrmvYjQi3e8Neb2h3WJkGzG3WSwfDEC9Lm2p7dD3qJy-MsCXWvBb6TyfqO5MCFwdIT4wLyTQ__&Key-Pair-Id=K3NV4LZ47N8M46)

3.  Click **New Custom Certification**.

    ![image.png](https://assets.usepylon.com/e6a58e21-be80-4777-9eaf-f73beeee94d9%2F1776693130913-image.png?Expires=253370764800&Signature=CKvCdjXtuC7k6sLOWAY4TjuQ01uFsZGpoq4ZLwWGCm2TBe1i7sQYImckDJMuuesClJZlKJTjvmlkVP0JXrjKUT7olNb0qt5qOU1ceBG9vtzx~puPI918-7jM34QlXVnSbU9kuvRzpP2AGTDAwENi1Gq7XpLKloLNpOc-cmVmYia3-dUlsvjEgjCcgYannQ0xhVASAnWCJcIMZEV-lu-dGe3kasRelSfOEekzcbBaQGdbJoMSJ0lb17GBKweyhga0gUir69um8VDFNZL9PURaNP84e3pxvKd-FiDdj0OUk3etuKBxVo2D4F1g6DZ147P5ANGRtOep158t9z64Vdl48Q__&Key-Pair-Id=K3NV4LZ47N8M46)

The custom certification creation workflow opens with the following three steps.
---
## Step 1: Certification details

![image.png](https://assets.usepylon.com/e6a58e21-be80-4777-9eaf-f73beeee94d9%2F1776693176197-image.png?Expires=253370764800&Signature=XXaCnnDGTrdbF1lSFbcmhozNG5~27zkUEgLsEt0Itss-FnMNDSwnSvKGac1phdPIbvdOagEPifhvB~CGO3WKe-kaJg~LW4hZJpaYZxfeg5yWK8jvI1tDPUHBXzywqsjbIvr-4X2aANyawfSf98LH4~ND73v3Y2cquVN8dMTaYGwNCfUdCZ5WzlJyhT1YwPkxFk7L3xtMroeHVgZw~mp8FzbUwu7xIEj6-7rfBFG~nRjovmCDZy~6TL~1AFWqkMy0LCwAl0JfnsxCtSPN2yP96zEIKl8IEPC47aVuYfGs9ThPgKzA~zaxYnCbigFfYUFCV46tvR7jBJGKVGpcacd~Ow__&Key-Pair-Id=K3NV4LZ47N8M46)

1.  Enter a name for the certification.

2.  Enter a description that explains what the certification covers.

3.  Click **Continue**.
---
## Step 2: Import HackerRank for Work test

1.  Search and select a test under the **Linked HackerRank for Work test** field.

    ![image.png](https://assets.usepylon.com/e6a58e21-be80-4777-9eaf-f73beeee94d9%2F1776693200334-image.png?Expires=253370764800&Signature=ntvc1E~0gKRvC6v0LhWsb2EpitQyQOZOS-CluVhtCXDqWiDJU-larN3NpS69m7U7JpweOSQ4caK3cP3EhKKqI~xKFeJUqGa7tRk-YrHfZS0fYHB9oaAmqbWtK-1h2KDetbycaqZHwI59-ssItyKT6BIWWaSc7ezQp~IwkeY-mJE2Nmzymcuq0GzKEcZWWmIK9NKRFcxFLKl9cmnh2C9R8gKBdeGq9Bq7k4v3q8yL3g9hpxT5O3e93r-lAOtu3fYV2Mq2xD697GPrJF001OCYU8oFlgDY19NzxqXhXCdOhKdNhp5bQYwXUl2kQGNBxVCnhl9ajrpEXmi3ksee87wX2g__&Key-Pair-Id=K3NV4LZ47N8M46)
